| | | | | | Peter,

In case you weren’t diligently watching the Governor’s State of the State last week (no judgment), you may have missed something notable:
**LAUSD was the only school district Governor Newsom called out.**
Here’s what Governor Newsom said:
_**“[LAUSD is] exceeding pre-pandemic levels in every category and reaching the highest levels recorded since the current state assessments were launched a decade ago.”**_
I’m proud of that progress. It reflects the hard work of educators, students, families, and staff — and what’s possible when we put kids first.
But we all know the work isn’t finished.
That’s why I’ve decided to run for a final term on the LAUSD Board: to build on this momentum and keep pushing forward.
If you’re able, I’d be grateful for your support as we gear up for this final campaign. Can you give $100 today?

The son of hardworking farmworkers, Dr. Ruiz grew up in Coachella, CA and learned at an early age that the key to attaining the American Dream is hard work and a great education. In the summer of 1990, Raul walked in the desert heat from business to business in the Coachella Valley asking them to invest in their community by contributing to his education. body:
Supporting students like these is one of the reasons I started Powered by People.
# [](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/43706?t=1&akid=240604%2E444211%2EWtCybw)
Folks,
Yesterday, I was back at the University of Texas at Austin, registering students, signing up volunteers, and helping more young people get involved in our democracy.
[](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20260115.W4WRBT&refcode=ema20260115-240604&t=3&akid=240604%2E444211%2EWtCybw)
[](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20260115.W4WRBT&refcode=ema20260115-240604&t=4&akid=240604%2E444211%2EWtCybw)
I heard about the incredible work that young people are already doing on campus. They’re building community, showing up for each other, and getting fired up about voting in the March primary and in November.
I also ran into Astrid from El Paso. I first met her back in 2011 at her mom’s naturalization ceremony. Yesterday, she told me she’s registered and ready to vote. That’s what this work is about—making long, lasting connections with people across our great state.
I met Janelle too. After we helped register her to vote for the first time, she told me that she feels that this is a year of change for herself _and for Texas_. People like her are going to change the world by getting involved in our political process.
Supporting students like these is one of the reasons I started Powered by People. I know we can win close elections across Texas when young people show up, **but first we have to show up for them.**
The proof is in the numbers. In 2024, the young voters in our program turned out at a rate of 79% compared to young voters nationally who turned out at a rate of only 42%.
Thousands of you helped us do that voter registration and organizing work. Whether you’ve volunteered your time, turned out to a community event, amplified our message online, or donated a few dollars, you played a part in that.
**Now we have to run it back for 2026.** I’m doing everything I can, including driving across the state to be with students, but we need your continued support to fuel this program.
[**So, folks, will you chip in $3 right now to help keep our voter registration efforts on the road? Every dollar helps us meet and register more new voters.**](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20260115.W4WRBT&refcode=ema20260115-240604&t=5&akid=240604%2E444211%2EWtCybw)
**[Donate $3](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20260115.W4WRBT&refcode=ema20260115-240604&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=24&akid=240604%2E444211%2EWtCybw)**
We’re up against a February 2nd voter registration deadline (less than half a month away!), and every student we reach and engage with now will be critical to winning races up and down the ballot in November.
Thank you,
Beto

subject: Three dangerous bills. One week away.
body:
Plus: Even Gavin Newsom is blocking bad legislation. Why can't New Mexico? | New for dpwillis67@gmail.com

| | | | | |
---
[|
---](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=86ee6f713b&e=567664f14c)
| | | | | |
They want to ban your Glock.

They want to kick ICE out of the state.

They want to gut the industry that funds half the budget.
The legislative session starts next week here in New Mexico. [Three bills. All dangerous. We have the details on each one.](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=4e6e34b25c&e=567664f14c)
---
[|
---](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=3cdcb9498c&e=567664f14c)
| |
🔫 **THE GUN BAN**
A new bill would ban any firearm with a detachable magazine over 10 rounds.
Standard Glock? 15 rounds. Banned.
Most women's self-defense weapons? Banned.
Sporting rifles? Banned.
This bill is worse than Colorado's version. In Colorado, there's at least a path to purchase. In New Mexico? Dealers can't even sell them.
We break down exactly what's in it — and why it's completely unconstitutional.

🚨 **THE ICE BAN**
Peter Wirth is pushing a bill to ban ICE detention facilities in the state.
His justification? The Minneapolis shooting. His quote: "Enough is enough."
He wants to send Trump a message. Here's the problem: Trump already responded. Funding to sanctuary states gets cut February 1st.
We show you exactly who won't get arrested if this passes. Tren de Aragua gang members. Child sex offenders. Drug traffickers. All arrested by ICE right here in New Mexico in the last few months.
---
| [Stream Episode Now](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=ee125ac4ca&e=567664f14c)
---
| |
🌡️ **THE NET ZERO MANDATE**
Mimi Stewart's "Clear Horizons Bill" would mandate 45% emissions reduction by 2030. 75% by 2040. 100% by 2050.
Oil and gas is 50% of New Mexico's budget.
Mark calls it what it is: a suicide bill.
Even if we hit these goals — which we can't — it would make zero difference to the climate. Not a fraction of a degree.

👏 **EVEN GAVIN NEWSOM GETS IT**
Here's the part that should make you angry.
Gavin Newsom — Gavin Newsom — is blocking California's proposed Billionaire Tax. Why? Because he knows it will drive money out of the state.
His quote: "I'll do what I have to do to protect the state."
If Gavin Newsom can put his state ahead of his ideology, why can't New Mexico legislators?
---
| [Stream Episode Now](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=73776544ad&e=567664f14c)
---
| |
📊 **WORST STATE TO RAISE A CHILD**
Wallet Hub just ranked New Mexico the worst state in America to raise a child.
47th in health and safety. 50th in education and childcare. Most violent state in the country.
This is what happens when legislators prioritize politics over people. And they're about to make it worse.

🚔 **MINNEAPOLIS — IT'S HAPPENING AGAIN**
Quick hit: Another woman blocked ICE agents with her car in Minneapolis. Clear lane in front of her. Wouldn't move. Got arrested. Screamed "I have a doctor's appointment!"
The camera was rolling. She knew it.
We play the clip.

Even after agreeing to the Electoral College, founder James Madison said the constitutional congress delegates were impaired by “ the hurrying influence produced by fatigue and impatience .”
Yes -- even the person who created it didn't like it and thought it was a cop-out.
We can't allow ourselves and our elections to be held back by this antiquated, backward system for even one more election. Pitch in $25 or more to help rid us of the Electoral College forever >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-end-electoral-college?refcode=011526_2&amount=25]
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
New Yorker: The Case for Dumping the Electoral College [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-end-electoral-college?refcode=011526_2&amount=25]
The Electoral College has been described as “ a loaded pistol pointed at our system of government. ” They warned that it created “a game of Russian roulette” because the way it distorts the will of the people could threaten our democracy.
We've already seen the popular vote loser win the White House five times, including twice in the last twenty years .
And this obtuse system of choosing a national leader led directly to the former President -- one of those five who lost the popular vote ( in 2016 ) but still won the office -- attempting to subvert the will of the people by twisting the Electoral College into a mess and when that didn't work, fomented a literal insurrection with supporters breaking into the Capitol Building to disrupt certification of the election.

body:
| | | Friend, **I'm going to be direct with you.** Our Mid-January Deadline is tonight at midnight, and we're not where we need to be. I spent eight years in the Army. I learned that you don't sugarcoat reality, you face it head-on and you fight through it. That's what I'm asking you to do with me right now. **We're behind. And the clock is running out.** Here's what this means: Every dollar we raise tonight determines how many voters we can reach tomorrow. It determines whether we can respond when we're attacked. It determines whether we have the resources to compete in every corner of this state. Michigan has been struggling. Our families are paying more for everything. Our businesses are being crushed by regulations. Our kids are falling behind in schools that should be world-class. **_We can fix this. But only if we have the resources to fight._** I'm not a career politician. I don't have party bosses writing me checks. You swear an oath to the Constitution when you join the military — including the First Amendment right to free speech. We swore to defend the foundational principles of this country. I took that oath seriously 40 years ago, and I still do.
| Team:

Pete Hegseth decided he's going to censure me, and is threatening to demote me and reduce my pension.

I got shot at in service to this country. I missed holidays and birthdays. I commanded a space shuttle mission and launched to the International Space Station while my wife recovered from a gunshot wound to the head.

My rank and retirement are things that I earned through my service and sacrifice for this country. Generations of servicemembers have done the same. Pete Hegseth wants to send a message to every single one that he will come after them if they say something he doesn’t like.

You swear an oath to the Constitution when you join the military — including the First Amendment right to free speech. We swore to defend the foundational principles of this country. I took that oath seriously 40 years ago, and I still do.

Pete Hegseth can threaten to reduce my rank and my pension. But I am not going to let him intimidate me, or anyone else. He is not going to stop me from defending our democracy from a president who is hellbent on destroying it.

If they think this is going to shut me up, they’ve got another thing coming.

body:
Updates on our pancake social, new endorsements, and more!

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/601cbe02e1b6/news-from-the-people-over-party-campaign-5860724?e=db7cb92046)

| |
# The Latest from the Campaign Trail
---
|
---
| |
**A Message From Tessa**
Have you been overwhelmed with the actions of this current administration and the state of politics? Feeling helpless that there’s nothing you can do to change the course of events? Wondering who has a plan to move us forward? We get it. This is how they get us to disengage—by flooding the zone with so much overwhelm, so many illegal and outrageous actions that we feel paralyzed and don’t know where to start. Well, I’m here to remind everyone that they've messed with the wrong citizens.
Joining our campaign is one way you can get in the fight and change the current trajectory of our democracy. You will meet many other like-minded people in our District 23 communities while having fun sharing your valuable skills and talents. Running a campaign truly takes a village, and we can’t win without generous volunteers filling important roles.
I completely get it if you're feeling helpless at times. But keeping this in mind always helps me: Progress is rarely linear. Our democracy has faced challenging times before. While we all need to take a breather sometimes, we have to dust ourselves off and get back to fighting for what we know is right and what we need for a successful government that is truly “of the people, by the people, and for the people” (credit to our late President Lincoln). Please consider attending our first volunteer social gathering on January 23 to learn how you can join and make a difference.
---
|
---
| | | | | | | | | | | |
**Join Us For a Volunteer Gathering on January 23!**
On Friday, January 23 at 5:00 p.m. we are hosting a “pancake social” so that current volunteers and anyone interested in helping the campaign now or in the future can get together, meet each other, and learn more about what it looks like to volunteer on a winning congressional campaign. No commitment is necessary—feel free to come and say hi and learn more! Bring a friend too if you’d like. Yummy pancakes and the fixings will be provided. Tessa will be there and happy to answer any questions you may have about her candidacy and the campaign. Please RSVP by emailing [alex@tessaforca.com](mailto:alex@tessaforca.com?subject=RSVP%20for%20Pancake%20Social&body=) and we will get back to you with the meeting location. Looking forward to seeing you there!
---
| |
---
|
---
|
---
| | | | | | | | | | | |
**Democratic Candidate Paul Chakalian Ends Campaign, Supports Tessa Lynn Hodge for Congress**

Paul Chakalian, candidate for California’s Congressional District 23, announced that he has ended his campaign for Congress and will support Democratic candidate Tessa Lynn Hodge for CA-23.
Chakalian, a small business owner residing in Yucca Valley, launched his campaign to ensure CA-23 would have a strong contender to challenge sitting Congressman Jay Obernolte. He has been a strong voice representing the people over the powerful, and has long been an advocate for affordability, accountability, and effective local representation in the District. Chakalian’s decision to support Hodge reflects a shared belief that the November election presents a critical opportunity for Democrats to unite behind one candidate and flip the seat in 2026.
[Click here](https://tessaforca.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6591574495fd0053ec4047783&id=acf6e9e26f&e=db7cb92046) for the full press release.
---
|
---
| | | | | | | | | | |
---
| |

**Final Democratic Challenger, Edwin Alonzo, Suspends Campaign and Supports Tessa for Congress**
After thoughtful consideration, Edwin Alonzo made the decision to suspend his campaign and support Tessa Lynn Hodge in the race to replace Congressman Jay Obernolte in the 23rd Congressional District. Edwin, a decorated United States Marine Corps veteran, has dedicated his life to service — both in uniform and here at home. His commitment to the people of this district, particularly his advocacy for the Latino community and working families across the High Desert, has helped elevate the issues that matter most to our neighbors.
[Click here](https://tessaforca.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6591574495fd0053ec4047783&id=6fac79c68a&e=db7cb92046) for the full press release.
---
|
---
|
---
| | | | | | | | | | | |
**Hodge and Claiborne Teams Join Forces for People Over Party**
Alexis Claiborne and her dedicated team of volunteers haven’t missed a moment of campaigning since Alexis suspended her campaign. A big goal for her team was always to unseat Jay Obernolte, and they are now enthusiastically working together with Tessa and her excellent team to see that happen in November 2026. They are excited about future canvassing, house parties, protests, and programs to ensure Tessa goes to Washington, D.C.
Hear Tessa and Alexis share more about their connection [here](https://tessaforca.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6591574495fd0053ec4047783&id=6b9fcd0ff3&e=db7cb92046).
---
| [|
---](https://tessaforca.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6591574495fd0053ec4047783&id=06bf28207f&e=db7cb92046)
|
---
| | | | | | | | | | | | **Recent Endorsements**
* **Democrats of the Morongo Basin**
* **Democratic Club of Big Bear Valley**
* **Redlands Area Democratic Club**
* **Hesperia High School Democrats**
* **Ulises Cabrera** _Mayor, City of Moreno Valley, CA_
* **Mario Novoa** _AD 39 Delegate_
* **Will Smith** _Vice Chair, High Desert Progressive Democrats LGBTQ Caucus_
* **Assemblymember Dr. Corey A. Jackson** _California State Assembly District 60_
* **Sarah Gardam-Thomas** _First Vice Chair for the San Bernardino County Democratic Central Committee_
* **Alan Vargas** _Immigrant Rights Organizer/Social Media Creator_**** "As a fellow social worker, I know that Tessa Lynn Hodge brings a deep connection to her district, thoughtful leadership, and clear values that will help bring the real change that people so desperately need right now. With a focus on affordability, healthcare access, and smart policies to meet the needs of our communities, I know she will work tirelessly for her constituents. I am confident she will continue to hold true to her values in Congress, and I'm proud to endorse her candidacy."
* **Joe Salas** _DNC Member - San Bernardino_**** "I do think that if we pool our resources and back one candidate, we will be able to take this district. And that is why I have fully and wholeheartedly endorsed, and will be supporting and volunteering, on Tessa Lynn Hodge's campaign."

---

---](https://tessaforca.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6591574495fd0053ec4047783&id=fb32405b15&e=db7cb92046)
| | Moreno Valley Mayor Ulises Cabrera with CA-23 Candidate Tessa Lynn Hodge
---
|
---
| |

Finally, thank YOU for being the best part of this campaign. I truly love hearing from the people in my community and learning more each day.
If you are in a position to make a contribution, either financially and/or by volunteering your skills and passion, please join us! With gratitude and determination,

He’s shot down multiple GOP attempts to carve up our public lands working to prevent Trump’s new BLM nominee from ever being in the position to sell off our public lands like he wants, and fighting back against Trump’s cuts to critical funding for programs in Colorado — from NCAR to child care to health care. → The field of far-right extremists running to replace John is growing. We’re less than a month into 2026, and we already have new opponents looking to flip this seat. We know that any of John’s Republican opponents won’t hesitate for a moment to rubber-stamp Trump’s dangerous MAGA agenda – like a nationwide ban on abortion. → And if we let MAGA Republicans win here in Colorado, that leaves ZERO CHANCE for Democrats to retake the Senate in 2026 or even in 2028.We can’t let that happen. subject: Under Investigation

Jason Crow For Colorado [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP21/1/88523/images/Screenshot%202025-08-21%20at%2010.50.41%E2%80%AFAM.png]
Team —

Several weeks ago, myself and five other Members of Congress with service and veteran backgrounds made a video directly quoting the Uniform Code of Military Justice about the military’s responsibility to reject illegal orders.

In response, President Trump called for my arrest, trial and death by hanging.

Last week I learned that former Fox News host Jeanine Pirro, U.S. Attorney for the District of Columbia, asked to interview me.

This is on top of the FBI’s Counterterrorism Division’s inquiry at the end of last year.

As a former CIA officer, I've seen democracies flicker out. I’ve seen what life is like when a government is rigged. I’ve studied this kind of political authoritarianism in other countries where you can't criticize the guys in charge without getting a knock at the door in the middle of the night.

It’s hard to believe I am talking about it in my own country, and the knock is happening on my door.

I've always tried to be straight with you in these emails. When these threats happen, it requires a strategy — because no American wants to live in a country where the president can weaponize the government against his perceived enemies.

So please: split a contribution between Jason Crow and my campaign today and help defend me from these attacks and allow me to keep fighting to defend our democracy. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/crow-split-slotkin?]

Dear Friend,
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zeua7o4ob75t1c4jopd9jfh8dif4se6kllc75p80_rp22sh2s8i6eor0slhm2o74c9h2bs) Yesterday I shared the numbers. Today I want to share the stories. Because behind every statistic is a corrupt official who thought they'd never be caught. A bureaucrat who assumed no one was watching. An institution that believed it was above accountability. **They were wrong. And we have the footage to prove it.** Here are five investigations from 2025 that changed the game:
* **1\. THE $100 BILLION FEDERAL CONTRACTING SCAM (October)**
* We exposed ATI Government Solutions exploiting the SBA's 8(a) minority contracting program -- outsourcing 80% of their work while pocketing over $100 million in no-bid contracts. This wasn't a one-off. It was a systemic scheme across multiple agencies.
* **THE RESULT:** SBA suspension. $253 million in contracts halted. A $9 billion Treasury Department audit. Seven additional companies suspended. And a 15-year review of 8(a) contracts across every federal agency.
* **2\. GAO DATA THEFT CONFESSION (November)**
* A GAO director admitted on hidden camera that staff "stole and backed up" vaccine data specifically to block RFK Jr.'s HHS reforms. They weren't just resisting policy -- they were breaking federal law.
* **THE RESULT:** The director's profile was scrubbed. A federal investigation was launched. And the nation finally saw what "deep state resistance" actually looks like.
* **3\. NIH PORTRAIT DESTRUCTION (December)**
* NIH contractor Joseph Olmert confessed on camera to destroying official portraits of President Trump, Vice President Vance, RFK Jr., and Dr. Jay Bhattacharya. That's a potential 10-year federal felony -- destruction of government property.
* **THE RESULT:** Contractor FIRED. NIH internal investigation launched. And a national conversation about the defiance embedded in our federal agencies.
* **4\. GEORGETOWN PROFESSOR EXPOSED (December)**
* We caught a Georgetown professor on hidden camera calling Black conservatives "coons" and mocking "stupid white people." When we confronted him, he tried to assault our cameraman. Police were called.
* **THE RESULT:** Georgetown wiped his bio from their website. The footage went viral -- over 2 million views. And elite academic bias was laid bare for all to see.
* **5\. INSIDE EPSTEIN 'S ISLAND (May-December)**
* We released the first-ever footage from inside Jeffrey Epstein's private island mansion. We confronted a DOJ Deputy Chief who admitted plans to redact Republicans from the Epstein files. We published unredacted photos that Democrats tried to hide.
* **THE RESULT:** DOJ was forced to respond. Media outlets issued corrections. Joe Rogan covered our findings. And the truth about elite corruption reached millions who had been kept in the dark.

_This is what your support produces._ Not theories. Not speculation. **Results.** We're now at **$81,000 raised** -- just **$19,000 away** from hitting our $100,000 goal. body:
A real chance to flip it

| | | | |

| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | |
Hey there!Something extraordinary just happened in Florida politics.Congressman Neal Dunn has decided not to run for re-election, making Florida’s 2nd Congressional District **the only open House seat in the entire state**. For the first time in years, this district is truly up for grabs.
This race is now one of the **most critical House contests in the country** and one of our best opportunities to flip a seat, bring real representation to North Florida, and strengthen the House’s ability to push back against Donald Trump’s dangerous overreach.
I know this district well. I ran against Neal Dunn last cycle, jumping in just three months before Election Day because I refused to let Neal Dunn run unopposed. Despite the odds, we ran a serious campaign, showed up everywhere, and **outperformed expectations**. We proved this district is far more competitive than Republicans want anyone to believe.
Since then, I’ve only worked harder. Over the past year, we’ve built a strong grassroots operation, mobilized an army of young people, and traveled the district nonstop listening, organizing, and earning trust. Republicans saw it too. Neal Dunn saw the writing on the wall.
---
[|
---](https://yenbaileyforcongress.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=642870bb478010796c7288d8f&id=42a180bf08&e=58216231a8)
| |
But this moment is also the most dangerous.
Republicans are already mobilizing to hold this seat. One candidate is a self-funding millionaire prepared to spend millions of his own dollars. Another is Florida’s Republican Party chair, rumored to receive Trump’s endorsement any day now.
**National Republicans will pour enormous resources into this race.** We can’t let them buy or bully their way to victory.
---

---
| |
This is a rare, once-in-a-cycle opportunity to flip a Florida seat and help change the balance of power in Congress, but only if we have the resources to compete early and aggressively.
I’m asking for your support today to help us seize this moment and finish the job.

With gratitude and determination,
**Yen Bailey**
Candidate for Congress
Florida’s 2nd Congressional District
---
|
---
| | | | | | | Yen Bailey’s journey began with her parents, who fled war-torn Vietnam. Her father, a South Vietnamese Air Force pilot, bravely escaped the fall of Saigon by flying with his crew and dozens of Vietnamese refugees. They settled in Destin, Florida, where Yen and her brother were born and raised. Witnessing her parents' sacrifices and resilience deeply influenced Yen, inspiring her to pursue a career in law and public service.

[ ](https://yenbaileyforcongress.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=642870bb478010796c7288d8f&id=684d367419&e=58216231a8)

A Tallahassee-based attorney and Tulane University and Florida State University Law School graduate, Yen has dedicated her career to public service. She served as a Senior Attorney for the Guardian ad Litem Program and spent over 13 years as an ethics attorney at The Florida Bar. Committed to her family, Yen stepped away from her law career at the Bar to care for her elderly father.

Yen is a proud wife and mother. She cherishes time with her husband, Steve Bailey, a lawyer and professor at Florida State University and former Army Green Beret, and their two teenage sons.

Yen’s dedication to civic engagement led her to co-found Every Vote Florida, a nonprofit voter outreach organization, where she served as Vice President. She also served on the board of Friends of the LeRoy Collins Public Library System, promoting literacy and supporting public libraries in Leon County.

Yen is running for office to address the needs and challenges of the average Floridian in the panhandle, believing her opponent, Neal Dunn, has failed to do so. For years, many in the district have felt neglected and left behind by Dunn, and Yen wants to be a voice for all in Washington D.C.

With her extensive background in public service and dedication to the community, Yen Bailey offers a fresh perspective for District 2. Her journey from the daughter of immigrants to a congressional candidate embodies the American dream and the power of perseverance.

Since then, I’ve only worked harder. If you haven't watched **Andor** --both season one and season two--you should stop and do that.
Go ahead... I'll wait.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..Yb3_dB5PNwBac52oAVDGw18dhE7tCZYTC0ontXqZSnU?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=184593645)
And before you say, "I don't like Star Wars" or "I've never seen Star Wars," that doesn't matter. Andor is effectively standalone. Two seasons. Twenty-four episodes. No homework required. This is not laser battles and space explosions. It's not boom-boom-pew pew sci-fi theater.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/4695ec6f-9e7e-4ce8-ac72-50c189867899?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
It's a deeply philosophical, carefully constructed series about how totalitarianism, authoritarianism, and fascism actually take hold. Slowly. Methodically. Surgically. Often without people realizing what's happening until it's already too late.
Honestly, I think it's one of the best television shows of the 21st century so far.
This isn't a TV review. I'm trying to sell you on watching it because very few shows or movies understand time and how long it actually takes to build institutions, and how long it takes to quietly erode them. Andor takes its time. It spans years. It sits in the uncomfortable space between moments.
The show picks up after _Star Wars: Episode III_ , when Emperor Palpatine has already consolidated power, declared emergency authority, and neutralized meaningful opposition. What Andor shows is what comes after that moment. Not mass arrests. Not cartoon villains storming the Senate. But something far more realistic.
Power is consolidated by building allies who work against their own interests. By controlling shipping lanes, resources, and trade to punish or reward entire planets. By shaping public opinion through propaganda. By nudging senators, institutions, and populations just far enough that they begin advocating for what the Empire wants--often believing it's their own idea.
The takeover isn't linear. It's patient. It's bureaucratic. It's disguised as order.
What makes Andor especially effective is that the people inside the Empire aren't written as monsters. They're careerists. Managers. People chasing promotions. People afraid of looking incompetent. People trying to feed their families. The show makes a critical point: authoritarian systems don't run on villains alone. They run on ordinary people doing their jobs until a line is crossed.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..Yb3_dB5PNwBac52oAVDGw18dhE7tCZYTC0ontXqZSnU?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=184593645)
And that line isn't universal. It's personal. It appears at different points for different people.
On the other side, the rebellion is just as deliberate. Sacrifice is the currency. They are the minority. They are radicals. They are labeled terrorists. And if we were watching the rebel story unfold on CNN or Fox News, we all know that's exactly how they'd be framed.
Yet we root for them.
Andor doesn't pretend rebellion is clean. It doesn't pretend it's safe. And that's where this connects to the moment we're in now.
The reason I'm writing this isn't just to recommend a show. It's to push back on a growing assumption I see everywhere: that change should come without consequences.
A lot of modern protest culture is built around comfort. Permitted protests. Approved routes. Designated times. 2pm to 4pm, then home. The belief that if you stay within the rules, history will bend in your direction. And if consequences appear, they're treated as proof something has gone wrong.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..Yb3_dB5PNwBac52oAVDGw18dhE7tCZYTC0ontXqZSnU?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=184593645)
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..Yb3_dB5PNwBac52oAVDGw18dhE7tCZYTC0ontXqZSnU?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=184593645)
Andor rejects that entirely.
There are consequences. There are always consequences.
If there are not consequences, then nothing is truly at stake. And if nothing is at stake, nothing meaningful is ever surrendered. Change does not arrive through intention alone. It arrives through loss. Through risk. Through choosing something and letting something else burn.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/39039f2a-73be-48dd-b897-3f544366409c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Andor understands something else that most political stories avoid: fear is human. Uncertainty is real. Being afraid does not mean you are weak. It means you understand the cost. Every character is terrified at some point--of losing their life, their family, their cover, their sense of self. The Empire rules through fear, but the rebellion is born inside it.
The difference is not the absence of fear. It's the decision to act anyway. And almost never alone. People endure because they hold each other through that fear quietly, without speeches or slogans. Bravery isn't performance, but shared risk in the face of uncertainty.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/d7ee6ba7-8391-4c20-8d77-ffe8ba7a35a1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
What I see right now are people desperate for transformation but allergic to the pain. People who talk about reform inside their party but refuse to challenge incumbents. People who say they want different policies until those policies make dinner uncomfortable or careers uncertain. People who shout in crowds but whisper when the room gets quiet. People who follow rules written by the very systems they claim to oppose because breaking them might cost reputation, comfort, or future access.
They want justice without exposure.
Revolution without vulnerability.
Moral clarity without personal consequence.
They want to be seen as brave without ever being afraid.
That is not rebellion.
That is a performance.
Andor refuses to lie about this. It refuses to comfort the viewer with myths about purity or inevitability. The Empire moves with cold intention. The rebellion moves with equal resolve. Everyone understands the price. No one pretends otherwise. There are no speeches about hope that substitute for action. There are no slogans that erase blood, prison cells, or graves.
Sacrifice is not symbolic in Andor.
It is transactional.
It is paid in years, in freedom, in anonymity, in lives that will never be celebrated.
And without paying it, nothing advances. The machine does not slow. The walls do not crack. Power does not flinch.
Everything else is safe. Comfortable. Designed to make people feel involved without ever being endangered.
That is the lesson Andor delivers without apology.
Change requires payment. Sacrifice is the currency.
If it costs nothing, it means nothing.

## Trump Threatens Use of Insurrection Act
President Trump threatened Thursday to invoke the [Insurrection Act](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGOnDAQxvGnMZ0RYxbDFi42iug2TRJFqZAxwzKJsTl7WLRvf-Kq66_-S5_0-_7ch7slT-Hxw65oeI5DwCN7ZMY0UMh7SuiYYrCO7YqJnM0jDapSWlYgQQ-TJf8aLsVkZkSFdYEGWt01Gjq4FovBVo9N1YJSgPrauVaNbQ2udrZViEoXZM61CkADQAVdqWcYrdaX2jZuHptWXCqciGMq_0UKvODsX_GJqXRxLbxZmLcs6ptQvVD9cRzlmsPZhOoxyD0L1Z-oM8bkJ6F6Tvu6SV4SWsaQJUdJ4Rn_o_xMltbxmd529F7awCTJodxSZMycJQW5UgiYI1uhepvk7Qa_6df2V9R9dDSJ-vu381o88k9MW5HMtB3kPWV9oh6rJf-B4C89_zTqPQAA__9e2pr9) to deploy military forces in Minneapolis if state officials don't stop protests against federal immigration enforcement. The 1807 law, last used during the 1992 Los Angeles riots, allows the president to deploy troops domestically without congressional approval. Trump's threat came hours after an ICE agent shot a Venezuelan man in the leg during what the [Department of Homeland Security](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDGyozAQRE8DmShGgIwDBZuQedMNqUGMzOwKyYUGWP_T_8JX-HF3db3Xfx7jAzlwfP7Glaz4NEY6cyAR2kaOed82csIpohNcaWOHeeJR19qoGhSYcUYO77EtZ-uJNDUlWbiZvjPQw71cLBrfg-vqljr09xnuqAlpNqj9relbU7K91moAAwA19JXxMKExbYOd81N3K9qaZpa0VX8TR1nIh3c6aKtcWstgF5FXLppfhR4KPZznWfn0_7K48kIPey70wI4UPimKyktKktVBkb52ChhVxI9gUCvHSPhKgfNVOygoFEH3T-E67XlR85LLzc6vk0PgbC6y54ocPiTyo_sOq78DAAD__6ObiBs) described as an ambush with shovels and broom handles during a traffic stop. The three men arrested for the attack were identified as [illegal immigrants from Venezuela](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD2u2zAQhE9DdWuIa4lSChVp1L20KYW1uLQ34I9Arm04pw-UK7xyMMCH-eb31_ZFEiXff1HiRUPZMr9bZFWum-T2rJV3lZJpV0pcZad2kw17dNBbsG7zJPGzDZ1fAjPytePFTm4enZ3tj-6xuMFONPgZrw7nad89D9yPzjqcpgkddbKctN5aZ63t7Xxxwd7IueFK4x5u42SGnr1oqZc_RbI-OMRPeXG97CV1cXmoHs1cfxpcDa75c5SmZ2VwPcEG194aXO1ocH02OP0MrvqozJA4A9XKTdlDKBVIldNxpvSsniuUAIF9A8mQJGemo0RpIN4DNZAY-U4RJCW5V8raINSS4MWZ_z45ksG1q4s_3hKjNHe63BNJ_L9dv3X4a8F_AQAA___wCZYK) who entered the country under the Biden administration, with DHS Secretary Kristi Noem calling it an "attempted murder" of federal law enforcement. Nearly 3,000 federal immigration agents have flooded the Twin Cities, outnumbering Minneapolis's 600-officer police force, while [protesters vandalized vehicles](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DGunDAYBODTQOcV9rKGV7hIQ_fSpkQ_9nj5I2Mj20D29hG5QuqRRt_Mr-_5mzhwfP-kDab6NEdcJaBW5JljOXKGrZwi2UobMlsqC8-qU1p0Ukg9O-LwmfvWGQ8oPFsYOejxpeUov9rVoO89lmH8Wl7eD8PYu-fYed3JngDtfMvmbuuk1FLKTo4P7eVCWvdPelm_vIam7-C4pvz4nTjWFT580on8sGlrg1lr3Uvz_NGoqVHTdV0Pn_7cK-68UdNRGjVRrCzYQtQ1g6ooe6aP2IljhRMnVrYBYkFgnHDiKHDCwyFTEMl7tshFuCNzfIuNYwTtKXARR8wotc3G7ReHwEXf3PdGHP7x6n99ehr1NwAA__855JAS) with threatening messages declaring the "only good agent is a dead one" and calling for Noem to be hanged.
## NATO Deploys Troops to Greenland
NATO members deployed small numbers of troops to Greenland this week for a joint military exercise after [tense White House talks](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0D2OpDAQxfHTmMwI29g0gYNNyHrTDVFhyuAdfyBT3ahvP2KuMPGT_vrp_XvOTwgx5O0vJLTky5zxOiMSYZ1DPl-1oqNQMjiChDU4OJcwy04a3gkuzLxCiJ-5b1brESWqBq0YzEMb8RBjs1sDbvB6UKtSvUYtR9Urjz3ocey19tgEe9c6IYwQohOP1nixgDG9Au38ogfWd7gGKrX9X0KmHX38lDfW1pXURLsTHSdTf5icmJyu62pdXtw9MjndaSanTjA5Cc3ktFXEHCGvPAMVTrWU4-Qr5gT1i29YE-QPh-ooOE71lY52pxSbatfjCjGG09ygLUGIPwD61WtvK78DAAD__zYQgOk) about President Trump's desire to annex the island.

Denmark, Germany, France, Sweden, and Norway sent personnel totaling at least 34 troops for ["Operation Arctic Endurance,"](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLHSpCAQhJ9GMyxBRQ0ILtlsL73QQhl25w4ZasD1fPu__F_hT7urur_uP8_laTFgfP22O5jiaYlw5gClAC8Y88EMW0GKdit2B8bN5hUX1SotWimkXpzFcC197YwHUNDVYOSop0HLSc712yiAYWynyU9qnHutnew2PW8zrOM49DDWaO60VkotpWzl1GgvV6t139lh8-swVn0LDgtx85cwljf4cNEHuNlor4N5l5Jy1f2q1KNSj_M8G0__7xW3fyvEwVXqUZgoZeGZdgEHUwLhIAW6xIsBYrDRCbYJnVDC2UvsmDNSFIWPPQm4IIsji2L_wV1es3HpxBAw65vwtVsM30TlRzd-jPoKAAD___ociho) including Germany deploying 13 reconnaissance personnel and France sending 15 mountain specialists. The deployment followed a meeting between Danish and Greenlandic foreign ministers with Vice President JD Vance and Secretary of State Marco Rubio that ended in a "fundamental disagreement," though the sides agreed to establish a working group to discuss the island's future. Senate Republicans are [vowing to block](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2ypCAQhZ8GM6egRdSAYBOz2XRDq8F27F0EC5iZmrff8t5HuOk5Vefn-3Nf7siB4-M3HmTrlpZI7xKoVsoLx_LMmXzlFNFXPCizx-J4AQmmlapVZlmRw2fRzWo3IqCuIasGM_ZGjWpqdjsA6F5Ok5ceNDny2qzdJifn9aAQdcP2SpNKGaWUVOPNbMqhMbrD3m-uH4SWtHJN-fY3caw7beGTXpRvPh1NsHutZxHdLwGzgLnutHMIlydg3tNB1yEBc6GIlQTMvRmnEWT7LbSZzqcL7DGW1oXk_7U1P4-zfWSiGDCuAuYm2_V8cwhczDXncSB_VTT1R8xeFv4HAAD__xsdgSQ) any effort by Trump to seize Greenland by military force, with Sens. Thom Tillis and Lisa Murkowski traveling to Copenhagen to assure Danish leaders of congressional opposition. | | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

## UNT Rolls Out Tuition-Free Program
The University of North Texas is launching a [tuition-free program](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGupSAURb8GO24AuaAFxTR2b9opDcJBSRAMHB_v_v3E-YWpd7Ky9vrztX7ZmGLef9sTDP6EsmboLQEi1PW4dygxebhKi9h8bK58QwW_CiYUZZxytXob02eVgzcb8zMfwHCtpreSM2PDYdjmIGilubZhCyN3WgOTow9s2rSXdojmgTHOFReMj9Nr09754Byb5FuqeSKSgY9Y6gsPQPixLaTP4_Fy5RySORCvRsZfRCxELL33V96cD_2ZiVieP0QsqTibiFjujLSEADXmnYYKQPGOGEumoVTaygm04e0hY6M94kEzdHrVslf70MZZTWJ6E7EM1firx5RiU5pItp82pn9K-H8hv434GwAA__-j7YnG) for qualifying first-year students whose families earn less than $100,000. More than 3,500 incoming freshmen are potentially eligible for the initiative, according to a Tuesday announcement. Students must [rank in the top 25%](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDGO5CAQRU-DM1pAY2wHBJuQzaYbWtgUdknYWFCe6b79ir7CxP_p6VX9-5q_PCY8t7_-AEuvmOcTfmoCIijzfm-QMQW4ckWqAeuav6FAmJVQhgvJpZmDx_SedRfsIsIkO7ByMGNv9CREt1vVx-UZw7SIPo4GRhXksJg-aj34vo9jh7bJhJRGKiGf42MZwhriuopR99pMI9MCAlIuD9qB4OVrTO_W8Vjz0SW7E12VPf8w5Zhy9YKVyn2kvPrUbmkUU45ebcw37fzj4JD45WtmyjWKKdcymHJCMuWkZsrdJ_FYADjdSJhPfpW8FX_wiKUSJzyg7XU_4OyKDdcPpoTVDEyL7fCYPoH0u7d-W_U_AAD__00kjfI) of their high school class and have financial need or be eligible for the Federal Pell Grant. Tuition for the current school year is $12,092, and about 70% of UNT's 46,000 students receive scholarships or financial aid. "_As the largest university in North Texas, UNT has a special responsibility to expand access to transformative educational opportunities across our region and beyond_ ," [said UNT President Harrison Keller](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGypCAURL9GMyxARQ0INjF7m25oCVzlViFYcB1n_n7L-YWXdnC6-_z7WX5WDBj3v-sBmt5bWiLcJQAR5MVfOyQMDs5UkIrDYtMLMrhFcqkYF0yoxa0YPktXO224m0QNWgxq7FU3cV57baTZBtvaYXSqk5MYHPQGTC8MhxbMWKN-YFwIJSQX7diYwVm3WcvHru_UNFYdB4eUckMeCN5r2cLn2dHYdNRBe6KzVO2fSs6VnO_7bq5I5VMIjgbcVcn5uVTJ-YrEwnpF66GwmDJ59sWxM6cDCzC6kDBFtmWAJ9zzejSnP-us3XljCFjUUHV8P1YM33b6nbOXlv8DAAD__72dhOc), who launched a $100 million capital campaign last November. Similar programs [have been introduced](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykUk1vozAU_DVwI7KN7eIDB7Jtkm1D-pGoKVwQ2A9wF3BlTCj59av0uNe9Pb0ZjWZGc06LtNSdHppD2UPsvmtTDDCPHTgHtminBozuFHyZUbtR6VGaC1hQBUGEBwgHmBeq1N1SUF_FFVIC-xDjOx4xTgVCfhtLChhXQlDCWC2BMI5VybgUiLE6pNjX8U0MYcwxQTiMVtWdkqqWEkWUUS4ijyJQ2hm7ci04-C7HultuPlbS9H4Xt859jV6YeGTjkc08z6ulbI25oR7Z3OJ4ZFNap2UHt3MaXGDqGqwemqC2AIGbtNNmCGiAMOKEC8pXres7L9w0k5RmGhxYL7zHHuHNJKGwUIO1P79y94bkLuX7RYQqlFPWd1O-sM-KoMu_9GLUjRfeJ69JkmwP6SmD7PoRbpPD41u7H9jx_Tn_ZE31nL_PQNcfLDKJ-0AaPYkRq9PjPlo_pYUpj2d7GtbXF3gqpix4zl5PRFX5_XZfyvw9DZTNf9XXRWS_w_zN9a_TQzbBvN6KM-_RNHNzlOlL3j9UBY2YfIkO0s78cg6OoriaYIx2lfpD80Xs1nNVXY6h822svmbddXrkdx5FTV_q7qd893-TucTkbwAAAP__YLPVxg) by several other schools in Texas, including TCU, Baylor, Rice, Texas A&M, the University of Houston, Texas State University, and the University of Texas System.
## USGS Discovers Huge Oil Deposits
The U.S. Geological Survey announced Wednesday that the Permian Basin [contains huge deposits](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGurCAQhp8GOwywiFpQ3MZub3tKgzDoJLOyAXbdffsTfYXTTSaTb_7v_7nPd4eE-_rfPcDWT0zzDkchqBXyvL1WSEgBnqlgLQGLT2_IEGYllOFCcmnm4JC-s26CXUQYZQNW9mbojB6FaDY7GuXj0GkpohNSDrcluC6E6HvXy1FAg_aECSmNVELehnbpgw_RezHoTptxYFpAwJpyWzeo8HEl0vfM0fr0aMhutT4Lu_1jamJqOo6jjemjT43zgKnpHJmaVkiUVvSOeHnlN3z5BeOv_bIqXHLDFyTCtPPF5QxUeEJqsg3P49wX0zMt1odDun7XvzX2tuo3AAD__7sYgrg) of previously undiscovered oil and natural gas in the Woodford and Barnett shales. Since the 1990s, the formations have produced 26 million barrels of oil—enough to fuel the U.S. for just one day. The report [identified](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkD2OgzAQRk9juols4xgoXGxDl223RP4ZgiUHI48Twu1XpNkDbD9v9N73c5tuNqa43r_tA019z3lacaeEtWKZlucdc0wBt0yxUojk8wsLhklyqYELEHoKNqZjUk0wjodBNGhEp_urVgPnzWIG5brOtjjjgA7R8tmp0Donfev9FbGJ5nzGhdBCctH2F9cFH2bvea-uSg89UxxDrLlc6oIV35bmdJweF58fTTJLrRux9ovJkckx2JQs4XsrSHReMDlStRWZHD8wnCmQVxCgwcWUYl7B2VIwEeQZnutfJ-SYYMUdqD7DAbTknZgcm2LCtp8o6Y4pfn_YmD429X8bvoz8DQAA__-XEYpq) 1.6 billion barrels of oil and 28.3 trillion cubic feet of technically recoverable natural gas. At the nation's current rate of consumption, those amounts would supply the United States with 10 weeks of oil and 10 months of natural gas. In some places, the resources are as much as 20,000 feet below the surface—beyond the reach of previously available technology. "_The shift to horizontal drilling with fracking has revolutionized oil production, and we’ve changed with it_ ," [said](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOpDAMhp8GuqAkA5mkSHEN3Vx7JTLYQKRARjgMM29_ykqrfYCtrF_-ZX2f_z2GB4QY9uUvbOTze07DThdHypmOYT0XSiEiPROHzBh4Si86CActtRFSCWUGhBA_Q1ujHyU6VZNXd2M70zop69XTbKxynZPWOgvWqIlu7Tw6142gAXUdfDkmlTJKS3WzzXjHCedpkrbtWuNs1UrCkNPR5JUyvYHn-CkczZS2Ovo15ydXtz-V7ivdX9fVnLxws6RXpftiUwbkkHaIomRxUCRgqnRfmt-RBTAT80Z7Fuf-YytSiAJ2FAuUMqfzmIjFlRLO6cCyqg-PzyvEGNjcq1YuG4T4xZd_99WX1_8DAAD__2TUkNA) USGS geologist Christopher Schenk. Several producers are [currently targeting](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0L2OgzAQBOCngc7IBmKTwsU16XLtlcg_a9jTgpHX-Xv7U_IK149G38zPdb46JNyXb7eBrc-U5x0eTFArlHm9LZCRIhyZsXJEDvkOBeLcy14LqYTSc3RIr3lso_UynlULVhk9nfR4lrJdrXFeReNV8kknpQcdtPSQToMepkEZ06J9l0mltOqlGqbOmxhiCkFO42nU56kZJUSsuXR1hQpPx4leb0cX8taSXWs9uBm-mv7S9Jffo3Z8QJfL0vSXGy8sDigbul0whLxHV16CV0fAYs0UhRJaeCTCvAvvSgFikZMo8NnqPIHISG2x8Xi8Y6xNM8plc0gfQP3fbXfb_wUAAP__J1KEWA) the formations for development, according to the _Journal of Petroleum Technology_.
## Aggies Develop Barbecue Sauce
Students in the Texas A&M Food Science Club have developed Aggie-branded barbecue sauce that can be purchased online and [delivered](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL_upCAURp8GOwwgohQU29jNtlsa5F7Gm-DgAs6ft9_MvsKv__Kdk_Pntt48JXrcf_sDXXvHvD7wVRO2hmXdrztmSoBnrtQqUA35iQVhVUIZLiSXZgVP6bPqDtwmwMoOnZzMPBptheh2Zwal1LxNKlocg41BwaBHO0Vp_GiHqSP3PRNSGqmEHOZ-myBADEHMetTGzkwLBGq59G3Hhm9fY_p8PfqQjy65vbWzsuEXUwtTS80xNH9cPdaWC_YxfV5U8LtlajlLhiu0ytQScwZeA-EjIN-2v7z6KyDnvO50nghcC2n13BUH54tSomompsX98JT-k9vPej2d-hcAAP__t2SAMg) via FedEx or picked up in person. What began as a small experiment has turned into an [ongoing project](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGSpCAQxvGnwQwLUEEDgkvM5tILLaDbkTqUWWnHmbffcoJ9gY2761f_-v7dppuLKW73v25FS685TxueJSER7tNy3DHHBPjIJVKBWEJ-4o4wKaE0F5JLPYGL6T21FVgvYJAVWml03-l2EKJa7ADON30rpXFBGQNCg2kGI2cBKEPoqmgvTEippRKy6WtvIMAcgujbrtVDz1qBECnvNS1I-HJlTu-row55rZJdiB6FNX-YGpkaz_Os_3t6XUemxstmahSSqVF2TI0fgLuVFzoANyp8duFI9ObJHVtY-Bz3Qvznze9uAwTu_Rcv7gjIQ04JA8W8MTVWu4XHGVOKRRvWivvqYvqE0e_mfFr1HQAA__80HIqa) that lets students get a feel for "what an actual processing plant looks like." So far, a tomato-based sauce called Game Day and a mustard-based sauce called Aggie Gold are available for purchase. The club is working on a spicy flavor called Old Army and a maroon-colored lemonade dubbed Reveille Refresher. "_We are not just learning food science; we are applying it_ ," [said junior Marcus Waskom](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkD2ShCAUhE-DGRYgogYEm5jNphtayHsotShT8pyf2285V9ikO_v6q_65TTcXU9yXb7ehpVfI047PkpAIj2k9F8wxAd5ziVQgFp8feCBMSijDheTSTOBiek-6AjsLGGSFVnamb40ehKhW28k2KD90WjRC9nOY1eC6RrVGQmjmxlXRXjAhpZFKyKav5w48BO9Fr1tthp5pgRApHzWtSPhyJaT35VH7vFXJrkT3wpovpkamRrccMcWAlMG9a3LbWSOcTI3XClOjkFe0TI0fFHcbL3QC7lQ4uV_kIWfgxUfcPfJw5I0nN3PKV2FiaqwOC_dnTCkW0zEtls3F9HGh_z34sOovAAD__77ZhPE). | Letter from the Chair
---
Defining Our Party: Together beyond the ballot
Have you noticed the recent shift in political branding? The Democratic Party has increasingly adopted the "We the People" slogan--a phrase many Republicans have long held dear, and one famously tattooed on the forearm of our current Secretary of War, Pete Hegseth. While imitation can be a form of flattery, I fear their version may ultimately mean "We the People of the Left." I sincerely hope they adopt the actual philosophy behind those words rather than just the optics. Closer to home, the stage is set for a pivotal 2026 election season in Nebraska. We already see several Republican vs. Republican races taking shape, both in high-stakes partisan primaries and some nonpartisan contests. While these internal debates are a natural part of our process, how we respond to the outcomes will define us more than any primary or general election ever could. Two qualified candidates may enter a ring, but only one can emerge as the winner. The true mirror of our character as the Republican Party and the NEGOP will not be who wins or loses, but how we move forward as one body after the votes are tallied. A House Divided Cannot Stand
We must learn from the 2024 primary, where internal divisions made it difficult to endorse winners who truly reflected the voice of the people. We cannot afford to ignore the biblical wisdom shared by our first Republican President, Abraham Lincoln: "A house divided against itself CANNOT stand." If we truly believe in and follow the Constitution, then the voice of We the People must be treated as sacred. There is a time for spirited debate, but once the ballots are counted, there is no room for an "I'm taking my toys and going home" attitude. Our Path Forward
To succeed in 2026, we must:
* Honor the Process: Respect the primary or general election results as the authentic voice of "We the People".
* Support the Winners: Come together under new leadership to achieve our ultimate purpose: electing Republicans who exemplify our principles.
* Reject Division: Refuse to let personal preferences outweigh the strength of the Party.

This upcoming election season will be a defining moment for the Republican Party and the NEGOP. I pray that we choose a definition of collaboration, strength, and mutual respect.
Winning in 2026 will require discipline after the vote, not just passion before it. Let us move forward beyond the ballot with shared purpose, respect for the process, and commitment to the Party's long-term strength.
Sincerely, Mary Jane Truemper Chairman, Nebraska Republican Party

body:
#

[
---
See, I get why some folks voted for Trump. He promised to attack a broken system. And it’s a ripe target. Even before Trump came on the scene, America had one of the most corrupt political systems in the Western world. It’s been running on corporate money, secret money, billionaire money. And it’s worse than ever now. _Citizens United_ was the worst court decision in modern American history. When members of Congress aren’t begging for money from Washington lobbyists, they’re trying to dodge getting carpet-bombed by super PACs. Senators get threatened with millions of dollars of attack ads over the votes they take. And see, _that_ is why things don’t work for ordinary people. It’s because the people’s elected representatives don’t represent the people. They represent the big donors! _That corruption is why they defunded nursing homes to cut taxes for the rich._ _Corruption is why you pay a fortune for prescriptions._ _Corruption is why your insurance claim keeps getting denied._ _Corruption is why hedge funds get to buy up all the houses in your neighborhood, and then your corporate landlord ignores your calls during a gas leak._ _Corruption is why that ambulance costs $3,000 after you just had to get your choking toddler to the hospital._ Yes, the system really is rigged. But Trump’s not unrigging it. He’s re-rigging it for himself! He’s a crook and a con man, and he wants to be a king. You can’t claim to be for ordinary men and women when you defund their hospitals and nursing homes. You can’t claim to be for ordinary men and women when you defund school lunch programs to help feed little boys and little girls whose hard-working parents are struggling to fill the fridge. You can’t claim to be for ordinary men and women when you do these things so you can cut taxes for the richest people in the country while you and your family business rake in massive sums from around the world. Donald Trump’s second term has already done unfathomable damage to our country and the lives of millions of people. And the people are beginning to see it. But only by regaining Congressional power can we stop him. _Really._ The upcoming 2026 midterms are our last chance to restore checks and balances. And my Senate race in Georgia is the single most critical contest: _I’m the only Democratic Senator up for reelection in 2026 in a state Trump carried in 2024._ **[So if you’re outraged by what’s happening to our country — and you’re ready to fight for the future of this Republic –– please don’t wait until 2028: Rush $5 to my reelection campaign in Georgia right now.**](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-jan26.wPRyEn&refcode=em260116-1-f&t=2&akid=1449%2E5691347%2E-bSSUR) Here’s the link to donate: **[https://act.electjon.com/go/donate](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-jan26.wPRyEn&refcode=em260116-1-f&t=3&akid=1449%2E5691347%2E-bSSUR)** The average online donation to our campaign is around $30. Please give what you can. Hi Friend,
Welcome to the latest New PA Project Education Fund (NPPEF) newsletter!
Earlier this week, the PA [https://www.politicspa.com/could-changes-finally-be-coming-to-pa-election-laws/141393/] House State Government Committee [https://www.politicspa.com/could-changes-finally-be-coming-to-pa-election-laws/141393/] [https://www.politicspa.com/could-changes-finally-be-coming-to-pa-election-laws/141393/] voted on two bills that have the potential to impact our voting rights: State Rep Mehaffie's Voter ID bill (HB771) and State Rep. McClinton's omnibus bill (HB1396). Both passed out of committee this week and will now be voted on by the full house.
An omnibus bill is a legislative bill that combines multiple, sometimes unrelated, provisions or bills into one single bill. It's essentially a package deal of different legislative proposals, often used to facilitate the passage of legislation, particularly appropriations bills.
HB 771 is sponsored by State Rep. Thomas Mehaffie (Dauphin) and “would require all voters arriving at their election precincts to show identification or attest under penalty of law that they are legally able to vote in Pennsylvania.”
State Rep. Malcolm Kenyatta (Philadelphia) voiced his opposition to the bill. The bill doesn’t address [https://www.politicspa.com/state-government-committee-sends-voter-id-election-omnibus-bills-to-house-floor/141399] the real issues at stake. “We need to solve problems of voter irregularities and voter fraud,” he said. “We do not have demonstrable evidence that leads us to make the point that we need to address voter ID in this way. Let’s talk about the issues that do exist. This legislation doesn’t address those.”
HB 1396 has a more recognizable name behind it – Speaker of the State House Joanna McClinton (Delaware/Philadelphia). State Rep. Ben Waxman (Philadelphia) complemented the Speaker, saying that the legislation is a “comprehensive approach to election reform that tries to dramatically improve the process and makes administration of elections much smoother.”
Among other changes, [https://penncapital-star.com/campaigns-elections/voter-id-and-vote-by-mail-reform-bills-move-to-pa-house] House Bill 1396 would also give election workers up to a week before Election Day to prepare to count mail-in ballots, a process that has been a bottleneck for election results in parts of the state, providing fodder for election deniers.
The vote-by-mail provision has been the subject of numerous lawsuits, including one now before the U.S. Supreme Court, as candidates and parties have argued over how election officials should handle irregularities, such as errors on completed ballots, that are not explicitly addressed.
The bill would make clear that county election officials are required to notify voters if their mail-in ballots have been rejected for the lack of a signature and give the voter an opportunity to “cure” the error.
Upcoming events
As Allegheny County voters prepare for the pivotal 2025 local, municipal and judicial elections, the New PA Project Education Fund (NPPEF) is hosting two critical public candidate forums to give community members the chance to hear directly from the candidates shaping our schools and courts. These moderated discussions will allow voters to ask questions and learn more about each candidate’s priorities and qualifications before heading to the polls.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/EA/EA016/1/99735/images/Pittsburgh%20School%20board%20forum%208.5x11.png]
Meet the candidates running for the Pittsburgh School Board and hear how they plan to impact our schools and students.
Moderator: Dr. Kimeka Campbell is our Senior Director of Campaigns and Engagement. She is a recognized community activist, political strategist, and civic engagement leader.
With over 15 years of experience in community organizing, political consulting, and nonprofit leadership, Dr. Campbell has been instrumental in shaping voter engagement strategies and building coalitions for progressive change. She co-founded Young Professionals of Color–Greater Harrisburg (YPOC), an organization dedicated to fostering leadership, advocacy, and professional growth for communities of color.

[https://d15k2d11r6t6rl.cloudfront.net/public/users/Integrators/04eaa6b2-88f4-43b4-b978-7bb0708f5838/7237344C447445787878394747342B75584E47375A57552F745265427662334B544A4A36505A58657A5871474B7A5A6E53705571424758325657365969365747/editor_images/WCM%20logo.JPG] #CourtsMatter
This past Friday, Courts delivered wins for Pennsylvania voters [https://www.democracydocket.com/news-alerts/a-double-win-for-voters-in-pennsylvania] . One ruling ensured that undated or wrongly dated mail-in ballots will be counted, while the other rejected a bid to purge more than 277,000 from the state’s voter rolls.
First, the 3rd U.S. Circuit Court of Appeals denied [https://www.democracydocket.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/11/445-2025-04-24-Order-denying-PA-Attorney-Generals-motion-to-intervene.pdf] a request by Pennsylvania Attorney General Dave Sunday (R), on behalf of the state, to halt a recent federal court ruling that Pennsylvania must count undated or wrongly dated mail-in ballots.
The ruling stemmed from a lawsuit originally filed [https://www.democracydocket.com/cases/pennsylvania-undated-and-wrongly-dated-mail-in-ballots-challenge-eakin/] in 2022, challenging the state’s instructions to county boards of elections that any mail-in ballot that’s timely cast but either missing a date or containing the wrong date on the outer return envelopes should not be counted.
After the federal judge’s ruling in March of this year, the plaintiffs appealed [https://www.democracydocket.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/11/441-2025-04-02-Notice-Of-Appeal-.pdf] the decision to the 3rd Circuit. The appeal remains ongoing, but today’s order ensures that counties will count wrongly dated and undated ballots during this month’s primary.
Second, a Pennsylvania district court judge dismissed a lawsuit by the 1789 Foundation to have hundreds of thousands of voters purged from Pennsylvania’s voter rolls.The 1789 Foundation, also known as Citizen_AG, filed [https://www.democracydocket.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/1-2024-10-29-Complaint.pdf] a lawsuit in October against Pennsylvania Secretary of State Al Schmidt (R) claiming Schmidt failed to maintain voter rolls in line with the National Voter Registration Act.
The group wanted the court to force Pennsylvania to remove 277,000 registrants who did not respond to confirmation notices in the 2020 general election cycle removed from the voter rolls.
District Court judge Robert Mariani dismissed [https://www.democracydocket.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/67-2025-05-02-Memorandum-.pdf] the 1789 Foundation’s lawsuit on the grounds that the organization lacked standing to bring the case in the first place.
In law, standing [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Standing_(law)] is a condition that a party seeking a legal remedy must show they have, by demonstrating to the court, sufficient connection to and harm from the law or action challenged to support the party's participation in the case.
In other news, this year marks the 15th anniversary of a landmark U.S. Supreme Court ruling that fundamentally reshaped the world of campaign finance. For good-government supporters, it’s a somber milestone. Find out why in Spotlight PA’s full report. [https://www.spotlightpa.org/news/2025/05/citizens-united-supreme-court-ruling-campaign-finance-dark-money]
The 2010 decision in Citizens United v. Federal Election Commission , they say, vastly expanded the role of big money in politics and ushered in an era of unprecedented — and in some cases, untraceable — spending on elections by ultra-wealthy special interests.
In Pennsylvania, the court decision’s impact on races for state and local offices was muted — at least early on. That is because of Pennsylvania’s notoriously lax campaign finance laws. Some state lawmakers have sought to tighten rules around so-called “dark money” groups, but their legislation didn’t make it through the full legislature. Continue reading for more on Citizens United and its lasting impact [https://www.spotlightpa.org/news/2025/05/citizens-united-supreme-court-ruling-campaign-finance-dark-money] .
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/EA/EA016/1/99735/images/DelCo_2.png] We are hiring!
Let's provide civic education together!
We're looking for people passionate about voting rights in Philadelphia, Allegheny, Erie, Lawrence, Bucks, Montgomery, Chester, and Delaware County to help us shape the future of Pennsylvania.
Join our team and help us provide civic education in our communities and register folks to vote!
Positions start at $20 an hour.
Interested? Contact jobs@nppef.org [jobs@nppef.org]
EMAIL US [jobs@nppef.org]
News You Can Use
There are things every one of us can do [https://www.democracydocket.com/opinion/we-have-more-power-than-trump-wants-us-to-believe-heres-what-you-can-do/] in our daily lives to help ensure free and fair elections. Some actions are small — so small that you might dismiss them as unimportant. Don’t. Every important journey begins with a single step, and the first is no less important than the last.
1. Educate Yourself
Elections can be complicated. The rules vary from state to state — and sometimes even from county to county. These rules also change frequently due to new laws, policies or court rulings. My first recommendation: spend time each month learning what’s happening with voting laws in your state and nationally.
Spotlight PA has an 2025 Election Center [https://www.spotlightpa.org/elections] with all the information you need to be prepared to vote this year, including guides to the big races, key dates, and more.
* New: Which Pittsburgh mayoral candidate most aligns with you? Take our quiz [https://www.spotlightpa.org/news/2025/05/pittsburgh-mayor-election-2025-candidates-quiz]
* Get answers to your questions with our AI-powered Election Assistant [https://www.spotlightpa.org/elections/assistant/]
* Everything you need to know about mail voting [https://www.spotlightpa.org/news/2025/04/pennsylvania-primary-election-2025-mail-ballot-how-to-request-fill-out-return] , becoming a poll worker [https://www.spotlightpa.org/news/2025/04/pennsylvania-primary-election-2025-how-to-be-poll-worker-guide]
* Everything you need to know about how to vote and where to vote [https://www.spotlightpa.org/news/2025/05/pennsylvania-primary-election-day-2025-voter-information-registration]
* Guides to Commonwealth, Superior Courts [https://www.spotlightpa.org/news/2025/04/pennsylvania-primary-election-2025-commonwealth-superior-court-candidates] , vetting judicial candidates [https://www.spotlightpa.org/news/2025/04/pennsylvania-primary-election-2025-candidate-vetting-guide]
* Guides to State College school board [https://www.spotlightpa.org/statecollege/2025/04/pennsylvania-primary-election-2025-state-college-school-board-anderson-huff-barlow-black-desmarais-mcternan-sogor] , Reading City Council president [https://www.spotlightpa.org/berks/2025/04/reading-city-council-president-primary-election-2025]
* Guides to voting as a college student [https://www.spotlightpa.org/news/2025/04/pennsylvania-primary-election-2025-college-student-voting-guide]
En Español
* Guía para votar por correo [https://www.spotlightpa.org/news/2025/04/pensilvania-elecciones-primarias-2025-votar-correo-como-llenar] , la presidencia del Concejo Municipal de Reading [https://www.spotlightpa.org/news/2025/04/reading-concejo-municipal-primarias-elecciones-2025]
* Guía para quién está en la papeleta de las primarias [https://www.spotlightpa.org/news/2025/05/pensilvania-primarias-elecciones-2025-votar-informacion] , cómo convertirse en trabajador electoral el 20 de mayo [https://www.spotlightpa.org/news/2025/05/pensilvania-elecciones-2025-como-convertirse-trabajador-electoral]
2. Stay Engaged
To protect democracy, we all must stay engaged day in and day out. We can’t just show up right before an election and tune out afterward. If we remain committed, democracy will win.
Check out a Montgomery County Commissioner’s effort to educate voters. It's now an emmy-nominated short film. “Running elections in Pennsylvania's third-most-populous county, Neil Makhija said he’s seen the slippery slope from election misinformation to political violence.” ( Philadelphia Inquirer [https://www.inquirer.com/politics/pennsylvania/montgomery-county-commissioner-neil-makhija-emmy-20250508.html] )
3. Share What You Learn
Once you’ve figured out what’s going on, share that information with your networks and community. It might feel awkward to bring up voter suppression or changes in election laws when we’re not in the middle of a major election — but local elections happen in off years, and special elections are more common than you think. Now is the perfect time to start conversations about voting.
Here, in Pennsylvania, we vote every year, twice a year!
4. Join or Support Pro-Democracy Organizations
Is partisan politics not for you? There are numerous nonprofits and grassroots organizations working every day to protect voting rights and ensure free and fair elections. Supporting these groups with your time or resources helps these groups do their work.
Check out the work New PA Project has been up to lately below. AND , check out our upcoming events listed above!
5. Become a Trained Poll Worker
Many counties face a shortage of poll workers, especially during election season. Being a poll worker requires dedication, attention to detail and a willingness to be trained. It’s a meaningful way to serve your community and help protect the integrity of the voting process.
Here are some resources that may be helpful:
Pennsylvania Capital-Star - Advocacy groups offer training for Pa. primary poll watchers [https://penncapital-star.com/briefs/advocacy-groups-offer-training-for-pa-primary-poll-watchers/]
Spotlight PA - Election 2025: How to become a poll worker for the PA primary [https://www.spotlightpa.org/news/2025/04/pennsylvania-primary-election-2025-how-to-be-poll-worker-guide/]
Franklin County Free Press - Poll Workers Needed for Pennsylvania’s 2025 Primary Election [https://fcfreepresspa.com/poll-workers-needed-for-pennsylvanias-2025-primary-election/]
6. Engage Your Elected Officials
Call and write your elected officials at the federal, state and local levels. Tell them that protecting voting rights and ensuring free and fair elections are your top priorities. Even better, show up at public meetings. Ask them directly what they’re doing to combat voter suppression. Be informed about pending legislation and urge them to support pro-democracy initiatives. This applies no matter where you live or who represents you — Democrat or Republican. Constituent pressure always matters. Don’t let anyone tell you otherwise.
7. Vote in Every Election
Yes — every election. That means local elections, primary elections and special elections. Become a super-voter. The more you vote, the more informed and engaged you become. You’ll also be better positioned to notice and report problems — like changes to polling locations or voting equipment — that could impact turnout or accessibility.
Make a plan to vote in the primary election, Tuesday, May 20th. When are you voting this year? Who are you going with? How are you voting this year -- by mail or on Election Day? As a reminder, the last day to request a mail ballot is Tuesday, May 13th!
