name: Beto O'Rourke (via LeftNet)
subject: How we can shape the Democratic primary
body:
We’re focused on spearheading Powered by People to register voters and get Democrats elected in Texas
#
The 2026 midterms are kicking into high gear, and _Axios_ just published a story spotlighting the work our team at Powered by People is doing to register voters and get Democrats elected in Texas. The piece highlights our work building Democratic infrastructure in Republican strongholds, holding rallies across the state, and making sure that Texas Democrats field a candidate in EVERY state and federal race on the ballot in 2026.
And we’re doing this in the most profoundly powerful way possible.
At Powered by People, we’re making a deliberate choice about how we engage with voters. As technology platforms, and our addiction to them, destroy our social and civic bonds... when the temptation has never been greater for political organizations to leverage their immense power to further inflame, isolate, and divide us... our volunteers are consciously choosing to bypass the algorithms and cold digital connections for the extraordinary power of meeting people in person, wherever they are, to bring them into the most important elections of our lives... to bring them out of the despair and cynicism that is manufactured for profit and remind them of their political power in what is still the world’s greatest democracy.
Our thousands of volunteers take the time to reach, register and turn out our fellow Americans, in person, to ensure that we overcome the greatest challenges of our time—authoritarianism, corruption, political violence—and win the elections necessary to lead our country out of this great darkness.
**And the best part about our approach to politics: it works.**
In 2024, our volunteers met young prospective voters across the state of Texas. We got them registered to vote, personally stayed in touch with them, answered their questions about voting, and nudged them until they cast their ballot. Young voters nationally turned out at a rate of 42%. In Texas it was 37%. In our program, young voters turned out at a rate of 79%.
In 2025, we were on the ground across Texas—recruiting candidates, having conversations in places that are too often ignored, and building the kind of grassroots infrastructure that lasts well beyond a single election. Together, we made real progress toward a stronger Democratic presence statewide.
And now in 2026, Democrats are running for every State House, State Senate, and Congressional seat on the ballot for the first time in modern state history. That’s 39 seats in Congress, 16 seats in the State Senate, and 150 seats in the State House.
Those numbers matter because they represent opportunity—205 chances to organize new voters, 205 chances to deepen relationships in communities that have been ignored for decades, and 205 chances to hold extremists accountable while forcing them to defend every inch of ground instead of running uncontested.
This is how change starts in Texas. Not overnight, but on the ground every day, everywhere. Not by writing people off, but by showing up and doing the work.
If you’re ready to build on this work in 2026, I’m asking you to [**join us**](https://act.leftnet.org/go/22163?t=1&akid=1460%2E2118727%2Exm49zx).
**[Sign up to be part of Powered by People and take your place in the largest grassroots organizing effort Texas has ever seen.](https://act.leftnet.org/go/22163?t=2&akid=1460%2E2118727%2Exm49zx) **Whether you can volunteer, help register voters, show up at events, or simply stay connected and help spread the word, there is a role for you — and we need you in this fight.
**[ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.leftnet.org/go/22163?t=3&akid=1460%2E2118727%2Exm49zx)**
Thanks for believing in the power of people. Thanks for showing up when it matters. And thanks for being in this with us — for Texas and for the country.
Beto
P.S. This movement is powered by people choosing action over despair. [**When you sign up, you’re joining a community committed to doing the hard work — every day — to protect our democracy and deliver a better future.**](https://act.leftnet.org/go/22163?t=4&akid=1460%2E2118727%2Exm49zx)

**LeftNet is an online political network fighting for progressive causes and candidates focused on social, racial, economic, and environmental justice.**

name: Elissa Slotkin
subject: Under Investigation
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chris Pappas for Senate
body:
As a former CIA officer, I've seen democracies flicker out.
Team —
Several weeks ago, myself and five other Members of Congress with service and veteran backgrounds made a video directly quoting the Uniform Code of Military Justice about the military’s responsibility to reject illegal orders.
In response, President Trump called for my arrest, trial and death by hanging.
**Last week I learned that former Fox News host Jeanine Pirro, U.S. Attorney for the District of Columbia, asked to interview me.**
This is on top of the FBI’s Counterterrorism Division’s inquiry at the end of last year.
As a former CIA officer, I've seen democracies flicker out. I’ve seen what life is like when a government is rigged. I’ve studied this kind of political authoritarianism in other countries where you can't criticize the guys in charge without getting a knock at the door in the middle of the night.
It’s hard to believe I am talking about it in my own country, and the knock is happening on my door.
I've always tried to be straight with you in these emails. When these threats happen, it requires a strategy — because no American wants to live in a country where the president can weaponize the government against his perceived enemies.
**[So please: split a contribution between Chris Pappas and my campaign today will help defend me from these attacks and allow me to keep fighting to defend our democracy.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260116_1.08csb0&refcode=em20260116-1&t=1&akid=4605%2E582294%2EEiq68P)**

More soon, Elissa New Hampshire is poised to be one of the closest Senate races in the country in 2026. Will you chip in today to help Chris stop the Republicans from flipping the Granite State red and expanding their Senate majority?

subject: I made a difficult decision to end my campaign
body:
Peter,
I officially ended my campaign for U.S. Senate and filed to run for Congress in Texas’ 33rd Congressional District.
I didn’t come to this decision lightly – I’ve put everything I had into my Senate campaign over the last five months, traveling to every corner of the state, talking to as many Texans as I could, building on the incredible grassroots campaign we started last year.
While it was clear that many Texans were ready to support me to the end, it was also clear that the Democratic primary would end up in a bruising and costly runoff in May. And if we want to prevent another MAGA loyalist from representing our state for six more years, that’s simply a risk we can’t afford to take.
So, today I am announcing my campaign to represent the newly drawn 33rd district in Texas. If you’d still like to see me head to Washington in November, I hope you’ll consider splitting a donation between me and Real Texas to get my new campaign off to a strong start today. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2025-allred?refcode=011626_1]

District 33 was racially gerrymandered by Republicans in an effort to further rig our democracy, but it’s still the community where I grew up attending public schools and watching my mom struggle to pay for our groceries. It’s the community where Aly and I are raising our two boys. It is my home.
The threats that our democracy and our way of living are facing right now are real. It’s harder than ever for kids like me to get a shot, and for single moms like mine to afford their basic needs. But I am more confident than I have ever been that together, we can beat these threats. That’s why I am humbly asking for your help to return to Congress to fight for North Texans, our democracy, and the American Dream.
If you can, please split a donation of a few bucks between my campaign and Real Texas to help me get started. Thank you for reading, and for all of your continued support as we fight to get Texas representation we can be proud of. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2025-allred?refcode=011626_1]
Colin Allred

body:
I’ll defend Pennsylvania with everything I’ve got

Pennsylvania is a state of builders. We’re a state of doers. We’re a state of get-sh*t-doners. That’s the Pennsylvania way. We put our heads down, roll up our sleeves, look out for our neighbors, and get to work. **And Derek, you can be damn sure I’ll defend that way of life with everything I’ve got as your Governor.** But the far-right? They want to bring the Washington way to your neighborhood, your community, and your children’s schools. After last year's blowout, Democrats hold a 4-3 majority on the Wisconsin Supreme Court. Now, another seat is open this April. If Democrats win, we expand that to a 5-2 majority and lock down the court until at least 2030.

“Cori, we love that you’re running again, but why would you want to come back? You’re free.”
A couple of weeks ago, I was interviewed by The Washington Post. The publication asked me about the reactions I’ve gotten from my former colleagues since launching this campaign, and I told them the truth: many are joyful, but surprised.
This work isn’t glamorous or fun—but at a time when our leaders are abandoning our families, communities, and democracy, it’s essential. People are having to choose between paying bills or putting food on the table. Our government is funding a genocide, attacking its citizens, and undermining our democracy.
In Missouri’s 1st Congressional District, our representative is too busy making his billionaire donors happy to actually fight for the people who live here.
I’m stepping up again because I have to.
We’re going back to Congress more prepared than ever.
We’re going back to fight for lower grocery bills, better medical care, and more affordable housing. And we know how to get this work done—because we’ve been there before.

subject: I wanted you to hear this from me
body:
Hi there -- it’s Derek Tran. I wanted to take a moment to explain what’s going on with my race.

The _Cook Political Report_ just released new ratings for the 2026 cycle, and CA-45 is now listed as the most vulnerable Democratic-held seat in Southern California.

There are a few reasons for that. First, this district was decided by just 653 votes in 2024 -- one of the closest races in the country. _Second, recent changes under Proposition 50 have effectively isolated CA-45 as the GOP’s clearest target in the region._

Republicans see this seat as their best opportunity to claw back power in California, and history shows they’re willing to spend heavily to try.

**It’s still early, but one thing we’ve learned is that early fundraising support really matters. Strong early fundraising helps us build our field operation, shape the race on our terms, and can even discourage outside groups from piling on later.**

I don’t take support from corporate PACs, so I rely on people like you to help keep this seat blue. If you’re able, a contribution of $3 today will make a real difference.

# Run for office in 2026
# We need to bring the heat in every seat.
---
| |
We need folks to run for office in the Upstate now more than ever before. We have seats to challenge from Congress to School Board and with the legislative session kicking off their focus on Chemtrails, Abortion Bans & Trans Right - we need good candidates who will break the supermajority so we can get back to the basics. [They even approved rate hikes for Duke Energy this year. ](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=46b571aff8&e=edbde6c9b1) Join me January 24th 10am - 12pm to learn more about upcoming races, filing takes place March 16-30.

# Spartanburg kicks off 250 Rev War Celebrations
---
| |

I’m excited to share that I’ll be working with our 250 Rev War Committee in Spartanburg this year to help coordinate, promote and elevate our celebration of this milestone Anniversary. Did you know we had 13 battles in Spartanburg County and the war was won in Cowpens with General Daniel Morgan? [The 245th Anniversary of the battle of Cowpens](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=af3999f673&e=edbde6c9b1) is this weekend, and their amazing Cowpens Depot Museum will be open at 10am Saturday amongst the reenactments at the battlefield. It will be fun for the whole family. You can keep track of all the goings on by visiting our website [spartanrevwar250.org](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=c0374f1118&e=edbde6c9b1).

Games will take place May 22, 23 and August 8 and [tickets are on sale now](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=43adf516cd&e=edbde6c9b1).

# **With limited political power, Minnesota Democrats navigate resistance to Trump**
---
[|
---](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=7ac2f1c674&e=edbde6c9b1)
| |

When President Trump took office last year for a second term, he [vowed to curb](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=ec61df7505&e=edbde6c9b1) legal migration and deport those who are in the U.S. without legal status.Now, after nearly one year in office, Minnesota offers a prime example of how his administration is enforcing immigration policies in a blue state.The [fatal shooting](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=1dde68ee02&e=edbde6c9b1) of Renee Macklin Good by an Immigration and Customs Enforcement agent last week became a flashpoint for the simmering opposition to federal agents operating within the state.More than 2,000 federal immigration agents are in Minnesota, and that number is expected to increase.[Read More](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=23fcb31e64&e=edbde6c9b1)
---
| | | | |
---
| | | | | | | | | | |
---
| | | | | | | | | | |
---
| [|
---](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=f64b384951&e=edbde6c9b1)
| |
Whew what a start to 2026. We had a packed first SPCDP meeting of the year encouraging folks to sign up to speak at public meetings, advocate at the state house and run for office. The legislative session kicked off Tuesday and they’ve already advanced a bill restricting abortion medication.
We launched Spartanburg’s 250th Revolutionary War celebrations at the Cowpens Museum bright and early Wednesday morning and last night the Frogmore Stew podcast team interviewed Sen Harpootlian about state politics and his new book on Peewee Gaskin.
Stay with me y’all, democracy is a participatory sport.

Peter, Court watchers are on standby this month. Experts believe the Supreme Court may rule against the Voting Rights Act any day now. Democracy defenders are waiting anxiously. The Supreme Court normally releases its highest-profile cases in June. _Obergefell_. _Dobbs._ _Citizens United._ But this year, the Court seems to be in a hurry to gut the VRA. Why? It all comes down to _Louisiana v. Callais_. The MAGA justices’ decision in _Callais_ has the power to gut what’s left of the Voting Rights Act and disenfranchise millions of Black and Brown voters. **But it also has the power to bless racial gerrymandering by red states across the country.** **If the Court decides this case early enough, these maps will be cleared for use in this year’s midterm elections.** The Supreme Court isn’t issuing decisions in January because it’s standard procedure. The MAGA justices are up against the clock, and they want to tip the scales for Republicans in this year’s elections while they have the chance. **It’s another perfect example of the Supreme Court being bought and directed by MAGA special interests. The Court is supposed to look out for the people—instead, it’s playing politics.** This Supreme Court believes it’s not accountable. We need to prove them wrong. That’s why United for Democracy is building the response to every anti-democracy ruling the MAGA justices issue, and creating a wave across the country for Court reform now. As a former CIA officer, I've seen democracies flicker out.
#

Peter -
Several weeks ago, myself and five other Members of Congress with service and veteran backgrounds made a video directly quoting the Uniform Code of Military Justice about the military’s responsibility to reject illegal orders.
In response, President Trump called for my arrest, trial and death by hanging.
**Last week, I learned that former Fox News host Jeanine Pirro, U.S. Attorney for the District of Columbia, asked to interview me.**
This is on top of the FBI’s Counterterrorism Division’s inquiry at the end of last year.
As a former CIA officer, I've seen democracies flicker out. I’ve seen what life is like when a government is rigged. I’ve studied this kind of political authoritarianism in other countries where you can't criticize the guys in charge without getting a knock at the door in the middle of the night.
It’s hard to believe I am talking about it in my own country, and the knock is happening on my door.
I've always tried to be straight with you in these emails. When these threats happen, it requires a strategy -- because no American wants to live in a country where the president can weaponize the government against his perceived enemies.

clean_body: | = Peter, We’re writing to you today with a heavy heart, knowing that so many folks in our communities are feeling shaken, angry, and afraid by what we’re seeing across the country. You shouldn’t have to worry about armed agents showing up in your neighborhood and tearing families apart, but that’s exactly what ICE is doing right now. They’re kicking in doors, grabbing people from their homes, and leaving entire communities shaken and afraid. This isn’t “law and order” as Trump may want you to believe — it’s chaos, it’s cruelty, and it’s deadly. Let us be clear from the jump: we are not sitting back and letting this happen. We are fighting back — hard — and we need you standing with us. = Just look at what’s happening in Minneapolis: federal agents have been involved in multiple shootings in recent days, including the deadly killing of a community member that sparked massive protests and national outrage. Tens of thousands have taken to the streets to demand accountability and justice. And in the chaos surrounding those operations, families have been caught in the crossfire — including reports of flash-bang grenades and tear gas striking a vehicle and sending children to the hospital, one as young as six months old. This isn’t distant. This isn’t abstract. This is happening to real people — mothers, fathers, children — just like ours. | = If you’re feeling shaken right now, you’re not alone. We feel it too. Every day, we’re watching people’s lives be upended by an enforcement strategy that refuses to respect human dignity or basic common sense. It’s horrifying. And it’s unacceptable. But here’s where we can start to turn things around: we can push back. We can fight for a Congress that reflects our values, one that stands up to reckless federal overreach and protects our communities instead of purposely terrorizing them. Right now, we need to build power and organization to take back the House majority and hold those responsible accountable. = This fight is about who we are as a country and what kind of future we choose for our neighbors, our kids, and ourselves. There’s a whole lot of folks out here who feel just like you do — angry, scared, and ready for change. And Becca is right there with them, right there with you, ready to fight for accountability, justice, and common sense leadership in Washington. We see you. We’re with you. # Hi Everyone!

---
| | **Caucus and Assembly:** It's go time. We need 30% of the vote at Assembly to get on the June primary ballot and so that people have a progressive choice to vote for! A candidate that stands for universal healthcare, affordable housing, good union jobs, getting money out of politics, and our Constitutional rights.
**February 1st, 2026:** Remember to [affiliate](https://zuriforcd5.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f6e59d8f916735599a3b9efd&id=0d44b248c6&e=738470dca6) as a Democrat by February 1st so you can support me at Caucus and Assembly. This date is a little early but it gives you time in case there are snafus.Tell your friends and family!
**Caucus and Assembly trainings:** We have trainings every Wednesday night at 6pm through February 25th. Our next training is Wednesday, January 21st at 6pm: Register [**here**](https://zuriforcd5.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f6e59d8f916735599a3b9efd&id=f1d18284fb&e=738470dca6). If that time doesn't work for you, let us know and we will find a good time for you.
**Phone Bank for Zuri:** Date: Tuesday, January 20th, 2026Time: 5:30pm-7pmLocation: OnlineRegistration [link](https://zuriforcd5.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f6e59d8f916735599a3b9efd&id=7967c3fed0&e=738470dca6)
Date: Friday, January 23rd, 2026TIme: 5:30pm-7pmLocation: OnlineRegistration [link](https://zuriforcd5.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f6e59d8f916735599a3b9efd&id=ec320a147f&e=738470dca6)
Thank you to all of the wonderful people who showed up, donated, got trained for Caucus and Assembly, and even passed out flyers at events this week!****[**Donate**](https://zuriforcd5.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f6e59d8f916735599a3b9efd&id=c744d583cb&e=738470dca6)**if you can****Community Events:****Celebrate Martin Luther King Jr Day:**
**Colorado Springs Free America Walkout** Date: Tuesday, January 20, 2026 Time: 2:00 PM to 5:00 PM MSTLocation: COS City Hall, 107 N Nevada Ave
On January 20, we call on our communities to organize teams, call your neighbors and classmates, and turn your back and walk out on fascism. Host mutual aid planning meetings, organize public service, but walk out to block the normal routines of power, and make the stakes real. **This is a protest and a promise. In the face of fascism, we will be ungovernable.******[****](https://zuriforcd5.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f6e59d8f916735599a3b9efd&id=52a1281e93&e=738470dca6)
**No Contract, No Coffee.** Support striking Starbucks workers! Don’t cross the line while workers are on strike.****
**Thank you everyone!**
**Let’s keep fighting the good fight for a better future.**
**With love,****Zuri Horowitz**
---
| | **Listen to my**[**podcast**](https://zuriforcd5.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f6e59d8f916735599a3b9efd&id=5616b4d978&e=738470dca6)**episode with Loving the Springs!****We talk about the importance of putting people first when it comes to all areas of policy.**
---
| | **Updates:**[**Donate**](https://zuriforcd5.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f6e59d8f916735599a3b9efd&id=20b54cdc1a&e=738470dca6)**-** We made our first [ad](https://zuriforcd5.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f6e59d8f916735599a3b9efd&id=671e873e65&e=738470dca6) with an Emmy winning editor. Now we need enough money to hire staff, and expand our outreach via door knocking, texts, postcards, and mailers.
[**Volunteer**](https://zuriforcd5.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f6e59d8f916735599a3b9efd&id=f7d30429a8&e=738470dca6)**-** Our outreach strategy will rely on volunteers & minimize paper waste. If you haven’t signed up already, please do!
**Social Media \- **We have the biggest community on [**TikTok**](https://zuriforcd5.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f6e59d8f916735599a3b9efd&id=6cfc103256&e=738470dca6)**** out of all of the candidates (we made it to 1700+ people), second biggest community on [**Instagram**](https://zuriforcd5.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f6e59d8f916735599a3b9efd&id=5559707f70&e=738470dca6) , and we’ve got a ways to go on [**Facebook**](https://zuriforcd5.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f6e59d8f916735599a3b9efd&id=0fb04f333d&e=738470dca6).
Your _follows_ , _likes_ , and _shares_ help a lot to let people know about our campaign!

body:
The numbers Polis didn’t tweet about Colorado’s workforce decline
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi friends,
Happy Friday! Listen to today's Mountain Minute podcast [here](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), or watch on [YouTube](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) or [Rumble](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). Here is a summary of today's top stories:
🏔️ **Here in Colorado...** Colorado saw rising concerns over public safety and state power as [Democrats rushed out their first 20 bills](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), many expanding government oversight. Homeland Security [investigated AI-generated hoax threats](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) sent to 11 schools, while outrage followed the dismissal of a child sexual assault case [under competency laws](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). Police also arrested an [Aurora man linked to Denver’s largest construction site fire](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).
🇺🇸**On the National Stage...** The Supreme Court ruled [federal candidates may challenge election rules](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), reinforcing electoral accountability. Meanwhile, President Donald Trump showed continued influence as [Republicans reversed votes to block a war powers measure](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) targeting his authority over Venezuela.
**🗣️ Commentary Spotlight...** Commentaries warned Colorado leaders are masking deeper problems, citing a [21,000-plus drop in the labor force in 2025](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) and a renewed push to [override local control to fast-track renewable energy projects](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) despite ongoing affordability and reliability concerns.
This is your Mountain Minute for Friday, January 16, 2026.
– Team RMV

**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[The numbers Polis didn’t tweet about Colorado’s workforce decline](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY MIKE O'DONNELL, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_I found it curious that Governor Polis felt a need to post to his half a dozen, die-hard, mentally-ill supporters on ‘X’ this week, a tweet to the effect that contrary to President Trump’s assertion that people are leaving Colorado “in droves,” Colorado’s population has continued to GROW under his august leadership since 2019._
_To support this assertion, he pasted a screenshot from factcheck.org stating that “since Polis took office in 2019, the moderate upward trend in the state’s population over the last decade has continued, although the data is only through 2022.”_
_This fact checker also stated that similar supporting data was available from the State Demography Office through 2025, although they failed to note that the State Demographer has already made one downward adjustment to their forward population projections. They may likely have to make another._
_At the start of this current legislative session, it is important for our portly governor, in his last year of office, to give his cis-Democrat legislative colleagues the confidence to create more unnecessary programs, raise more fees, and spend more taxpayer funds than they did during the last budget cycle._

**[Colorado Democrats Move Quickly Toward Greater State Oversight In First 20 Bills](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* **Democrats signal expanded state control early:** Colorado House Democrats introduced their first 20 bills of the 2026 session with a clear focus on expanding state involvement in housing, labor, and consumer regulation—setting the tone for a more interventionist agenda.
* **Labor bill revives union fight:** One of the top priorities would eliminate Colorado’s unique second-election requirement for union security agreements, a long-sought goal of organized labor that critics argue weakens worker choice and tilts power toward unions over employees and employers.
* **Housing and consumer rules raise cost concerns:** Bills promoting affordable housing on public land and expanding price disclosure and “excessive pricing” rules are framed as consumer protections, but opponents warn they risk higher costs, more red tape, and unintended consequences for local governments and businesses.

**[State signals renewed push to override local control on renewable energy siting](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY CORY GAINES, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* **State hints at overriding local control:** Gov. Jared Polis signaled that “making it easier” to permit energy projects likely means loosening or bypassing local government authority to speed renewable energy siting, raising alarms for rural and mountain communities.
* **Renewables, not ‘all of the above’:** The commentary argues Polis’ energy push is narrowly focused on renewables—not fossil fuels—despite broader grid reliability and cost concerns, reinforcing fears that Front Range priorities will be imposed on less-populated regions.
* **PUC rewrite could shift power upward:** Potential changes to the Public Utilities Commission and its governing laws are flagged as another avenue for centralizing control, limiting counties’ ability to influence where large-scale energy projects are built.

It had nothing to do with the case itself—just how much time each side would have. But the aside drew a brief laugh before judges turned to a record years in the making._ __
[**Behind the zero: What Colorado’s opening day didn’t say about the true cost of lawmaking**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)

Janice Rich said Wednesday, recounting a recent exchange as she stood on the Senate floor during opening session. Inside the chamber, legislative leaders spoke about shared goals and economic pressure on families. What didn’t make it into the speeches, according to Rich, was where many of the real financial consequences of those bills are already hiding.
[**Griswold, county clerks urge Polis to reject clemency for Tina Peters ahead of appellate arguments**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) **BY JEN SCHUMANN | STATE | JANUARY 14** _With Peters’ appeal heading into oral arguments, Griswold and the Colorado County Clerks Association put it in writing for Gov. Jared Polis: don’t step in. The Jan. 13 letter carries three signatures: Griswold’s, Jackson County Clerk & Recorder Hayle Johnson’s and Colorado County Clerks Association executive director Matt Crane’s._[****](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)

Friend, What happened last week in Minneapolis is an outrage. Renee Nicole Good was a mother of three kids, and she deserved safety and dignity, as every person does in this country. My heart is with her loved ones and with the entire Twin Cities community. While unsurprising, it was deeply irresponsible for Secretary Noem to make claims and mischaracterize the events before any investigation was completed or facts were known. This conduct underscores the urgent need for an immediate investigation and full transparency for the American people. Everyone in this country has a fundamental right to safety. As a member of the Homeland Security Committee, I will work tirelessly to conduct rigorous oversight, demand answers, and ensure accountability for what happened today. This conduct underscores the urgent need for an immediate investigation and full transparency for the American people. Everyone in this country has a fundamental right to safety. As a member of the Homeland Security Committee, I will work tirelessly to conduct rigorous oversight, demand answers, and ensure accountability for what happened today. But I also know this: oversight alone is not enough. If we want accountability, if we want a government that tells the truth, and if we want leadership that takes public safety seriously, we need a House majority that will use its power responsibly. We need to take back the House. If you believe in oversight, accountability, and the fundamental right to safety, I’m asking you to support this campaign. This is a frontline swing seat, and winning here is key to flipping the House. = | = | = ---|--- = | = = | = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your secure donation will go through immediately. President Trump is backing our ICE heroes |
---
| | [ ](https://electdavidflippo.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9aba26b775663b53df718fc1a&id=bfeb179b99&e=273c9a71fb)
---
| | Peter ,
My fellow Nevada patriots, President Trump is backing our ICE heroes! He is empowering them to **arrest dangerous criminal aliens, remove threats from our streets, and partner with local law enforcement.** I stand with him to keep fentanyl traffickers and violent offenders out of Nevada communities! We're finally protecting families and neighborhoods with real enforcement and no-nonsense deportations of those who break our laws. _Steven Horsford wants to weaken ICE and reverse this progress._ His record shows **a pattern of aligning with efforts to restrict ICE's authority and funding** : opposing key Republican-led enforcement measures like the Secure the Border Act (H.R. 2), supporting policies that critics say would tie ICE's hands, reduce deportations of criminal aliens, and prioritize oversight over aggressive action against threats. **That's not going to happen on my watch.**
---
| [ ](https://electdavidflippo.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9aba26b775663b53df718fc1a&id=5160039fd9&e=273c9a71fb)
---
| As your next Congressman for Nevada's 4th District, I'll fight to fully fund ICE, strengthen partnerships with local police, deploy advanced technology and infrastructure—including finishing the wall—and ensure every tool is used to deport criminal aliens and _**keep our communities safe for law-abiding Nevadans.**_ Our opponents, the **open-border liberals like Steven Horsford, are trying to stop us.** They want to tie ICE's hands and **_put Nevada families at risk._** But that won't work on us. Make your voice heard.

## Double Amputee Climbs World’s Highest Peaks
Hari Budha Magar, [a British Army veteran](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LvOnDAQhuGrMZ1X9rDAT0GRhm7TpkQ-jJdJfED27K64-4gkd5BmmpFefXp-PLaHoUj5-d0kXMIzbBzKlvHTIjJj3Uw6XozoIiXbpvZKibgxer-BglEqLfW4eUPx3O6dXwIiYN_hoqfxa5infhi7fZl7hDD0Vn_ZSc_K9m4OwzyivbteDUp1tFw1pfUIWgFMNzcYcP04TMpZ430Qd4WeuNTbz0KZdwzxLG-sN1dSF5ed-Wii_yZgFbDm8yiNr5eA9QoLWJW-zixgjRSw8RlRwGorMbVdfkyVb2SsJkuLriRsMlBtLH152YjyH4PkIv8ayJ2eOzaWB5pfsmSJb6yndCUzZcwsYO3q4o8PxUhtnMRdPZOh-Gcw_7f0e4HfAQAA__-Q1ZYQ) who lost both legs in Afghanistan, has become the first double above-knee amputee to summit the highest mountain on each continent. The 46-year-old reached the top of Antarctica’s Mount Vinson on Jan. 6, completing his seven-year mission known as the [Seven Summits](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L1u8yAUxvGrwVssPmx4MzC8i7d07YiIOcRUB2PBiVHuvkrVO-j-6Cc9_8-bu_mEaX98-Aw2PqKjWNwOvSEQQXU-H08CWDHlezPtmXOiRhCCk1zqCxcXoV3wCV9uGoKNABLUAFYY_W--GjXrYbMhxqi4gRg9n5W-CuUnFQR4Fe8TBz8k-9a4EFoKLqUZ19nLVenZ8PXuQ4hs4hASlTp-lbTTBhFf5YQ6riUPaDeiozH1n8mFyaX3PlL1JyBt0LeC0EvF8N4yuTQ4Yb_8PmFyGaoNR0-IqWnDJv7IPuGPS38Oclr5HQAA__8gzHjQ). Hari battled addiction, depression, and even a government ban on disabled climbers in Nepal before standing atop Everest in 2023. The climber now uses his platform to raise awareness for disability rights and veteran causes, saying his mission is to “inspire others to climb their own mountain.” [Watch a report here](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGK7CAUxvGnMd0EPSaaKSwuXFIMzMJWW4rR48RFJyE5GZm3X7KvsO33wa_4f93t3aWcno8PV9DER7QUF_vEumckws26sh6E6HMq0673o5REO2EIFjioCxcXoWxwKb9t1wQTEQFlg0ZoNfRXLXvVzEbCJDz3IUwy-olrrgU6qYdOXa9ceGiSOTUuhALBAXTrewdeql5zP7kQIus4hkTL1n4v6UkzxvxeXri1filNNjPRujP5j8HIYKy1tu_loGPC8z8XR35mcnwx-d_fhpHXtbt9Ds1mwlpTzmlXmnX8UVzKvyT9ucXLwE8AAAD__yeAdBQ).
## Parents Swap Smartphones for Landlines
Parents in Illinois are holding the line on smartphones, vowing not to give their kids one until eighth grade, [opting for landline phones](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0M2O2yAUxfGnsXdEfMSQLFhUqrKbbrtEGC72bcEguE46b19NXmHWP-kc6f_7w314zHhsv3wBm7bkKFV3wGtkIILufGknAYSMZR1mnKUgDYIYneRSMy6Y0C56zJ_uOkebACSoGaww-rbcjVr0vNsQVhNXSBClMmbRIE0A5ZWB-y1FdZ_Rfq1xIbQUXEpzCYuXQenF8LD6GNN05RCRar_8qXjQDil_1if0S6hlznYnamNSPyb5mOSjQW0ZvmiSj63Xs7GaWPMdDhpsnL11HMBoB-zsL8bBXkg7y_6IGQ8YDP6FfA58AhPidpNXLib1OKm4Uc8eYFI_w-5pa_S-7za2F-aMQ5vpyrfiMb-Bvh30aeX_AAAA__8VFY9o) instead. The idea, sparked by Meg Kate McAlarney and her husband Kyle, reflects a growing trend of families embracing the [Wait Until 8th](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykzzFuwyAUANDT2Fss-LbBGRi6ZEvXjojAx_4VmMh8B-X2VXuFXuBJ7-tu744S7euny2jiGi3HYndsNSEzHtbl58mIPlF-VF3PnIkrYwgWBKiLkBepbHCU3nbqg4mIgGOPRmq1zFc9zqrfjJ_cGHHBq5i0Uk7IEMIo58cCi0LEqSfzqwkpFUgBoAc_O_CjmrXwDxdC7CaBgbgcw3ehnTeM6V1eeAy-5D6ZjflZu_Gjg1sHt9ba0BzxuTOlhbehHGsHt_4w4dkoJapKd5NYs6P0B_C_5y8DPwEAAP__4JZvPQ) approach, which encourages delaying smartphones to help preserve childhood. A video of their 8-year-old daughter using her new [Tin Can phone](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DGSozAQQNHTQAYlNSCZQMEmzrzphqpGanDvSIJCbbt8-ynPFSb62Qv-v5u_IScu21_M5NZt9bLuvtCrJhKh02M-HkIUEuel2vrImaUKxehBgemU7rTxETm9_dhGtxIBDS05bc1lmu0wmfbuwCzBXNQSBj1HmmY12jADKh0nq1DZlt1HU1ob0ArA9mFCCIOZrAoLxrg2o6LIsp_9_52L3GlN7_1JZx_23CZ3FzlqM_xp4NrAVbgELP0Xx9rA9cCNPsVlf0gnXLqApT1dPF6cEldjm1FtGTn9YPLrC08H3wEAAP__emFylA) on Christmas went viral on TikTok, drawing over 3 million views. The retro-style phones let kids call approved contacts without internet or screens. Parents say it’s a screen-free, nostalgic way to keep kids connected while pushing back on smartphone pressure in younger grades.
## Teddy Bear Toss Fills Ice With 81,796 Toys
The Hershey Bears, a minor league hockey team in Pennsylvania, turned the ice into [a sea of stuffed animals](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLFuwyAUAL_G3ogA22APDF28pWtHROARvxZMBC-x_PdV-gudT7qT7utqrw4T7vdPl8HEe7QUi93haAmIoFqXH08C8Anzren2zBmpEYRgJZeKccGEssFhOu3YBxMBJAw9GKHVPC16mFS_mSAmPgvFFyfGOI9TjFrxJUwiBO2XG_Ro3jYuhJKCS6kvfnLSD2rS3N9cCLEbOQSkUi_fBXfaIKazvKBefMl9MhvRo3XDRyfXTq4VXMoHVnjTTq5b8T9wsuj2xmir5WCz0ItijZ4xQmBux-xSY2WnwtADi6Uyv7mKdHZy7asJjwNTwqZ0N_J7dpj-wvTvYy8jfwMAAP__5YCCvA) on Jan. 4 as fans tossed 81,796 plush toys after the team’s first goal—just three minutes into the game. Now in its 25th year, [the Teddy Bear Toss](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykULuO4yAU_Rrc2eJhQ1JQbOMu226JsLnYdwXGgptE-ftRMvMH0x3pHJ3Xv5u7eUx4bH99Bhu36CgWd8CzJSCC6nw-7wSwJsxLM-2eM1IjCMFJLnXPRS-0Cx7Ty41dsBFAgurACqMv09WoSXe7NYsSow4jVyFc-egXGcXFaMGVN_wKa4f27caF0FJwKc2wTl6uSk-Gr4sPIbKRQ0Aqdfhf8KAdYnqVB9RhLblLdic6mfrD5Mzk3KhUhDbsUNsOr9O_RUzOn8Ib-oP6H6pfwNfWv-d8455Ka0zOXbXhfGJK2LRhI9-yx_TJol-f9LDyKwAA__8FRH2h) collects toys for kids in need across central Pennsylvania. One of the event’s biggest champions is high school junior Gabby Kerchner, who started a nonprofit called [Gabby’s Acts of Kindness](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkbGunTAMQL8GNl8lDjgwMHRhe107opA4kL5AEMl9lL-vaKfO3Y505CPZ_vExfZgQw758NxsPfvFT8Wna-cqRS-FzMtvxLsw2hm3OOr-3LZRc2LkJBRIICZImZ0K8p6Z2g2dGVjUPUlPX9lq1VK9D3yvfkjJKY0dezKgEKUbphRO261wdhqcmpCSUAlG_bGvQKmq1sLNxzleNYBdKOl8_U9jLyj7e6YvPl01bHYe1lCNX6luFY4XjdV0vn3416rEVjuYswUaucMxHOkuucFyT_eT7AT7zyjfMbM5HLGae7wzGFkgePsPuds4ZVo5HBv_mCP9MwHOKvwwl5afQogSjSVpPDczUemhMj9ATKVDCsuhmdtpQfQ7uuEKMIZOuGrFsJsQ_-5T_fsTXgL8DAAD__07vnbY). Her group has helped collect more than 125,000 bears over the years. Those toys are now in the hands of local schoolkids, hospitals, and military families, proving that a little mayhem on the ice can make a big difference. [Watch the video](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L1u6yAYxvGrgS0WXwZnYDjSUZYqVdUOHRGGl5gWQmRex8rdV-ktdH0e6Tf8P8_u7HPJ18urr2DTJTlMzV1h7wUQYXW-3jYECCXXuZu-1ZqxI8ToBBP6wPiBaxd9Lg-naLQJQICkYLnR03g0ctR0sVGmafKRqcDT0aTjLCceJ68kSG6UmGm2T41xrgVnQpghjF4EqUfDwuxjTEQxiBnbOny1fMUFUnm0O6xDaJUWuyDeOpH_iDgRcdr3fXi0DbcZnv9z8RgWIk93Iv-_VVW-8fD-8dLoauNtz6Xkrg1R7FJ9Lr8k_rnF3YqfAAAA__9uTnSt).

_**by Lawrence Winnerman, BAM COO and Writer**_
###### (* Apologies to the band "[The Airborne Toxic Event](https://substack.com/redirect/36790662-fb34-4d45-8302-f161c222e58b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)", whom I adore.)
* * *
There's being _angry_ about what's happening on the streets of Minneapolis right now, and then there's being _terrified_ for our communities and for the state of our nation.
In the two weeks since an ICE agent shot and killed 37-year-old Renee Nicole Good--a U.S. citizen and mother--Minneapolis has erupted in protest, grief, and fear. Thousands have taken to the streets, not just in Minneapolis, but in cities across the country, demanding accountability and an end to a federal force that many people clearly see as hostile and not protective.
But beyond the anger that we are all feeling, a deeper and more deadly question needs to be answered:**it possible that ICE and federal immigration agents are deploying a toxic chemical weapon against the people of Minneapolis?**
And while it feels crazy to say it like this--I don't mean "just" tear gas. I mean something far more dangerous -- something that has been described elsewhere as a _toxic smoke weapon capable of severe injury_.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/70eca207-1111-48ba-ad7c-e8d525f8d954?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---

[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYmx1ZWFtcC5jby9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.HpzHXq3smlNeeMIG7FEUdzWwZZozi9oQPDjtUDrz-Tw?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=184809132)
* * *
#### We Already Know DHS Has Used Chemical Irritants
Let's start with what we know we can confirm.
Multiple news agencies and dozens of on-the-ground videos show federal agents in Minneapolis deploying chemical irritants and tear gas to disperse crowds and quell protests in the days since Good's killing. [AP News reports that plumes of tear gas and eye irritants have filled the air around demonstrations](https://substack.com/redirect/13f1edae-8751-4dde-a71b-1d925543d825?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
The NYT recently reported that ICE targeted a family car with six children in it, and that [the children suffered lung burns so severe that a 6-month-old infant was rendered unconscious and unable to breathe](https://substack.com/redirect/9c3ad538-8278-47f5-bb99-2b616ffe7d2e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Footage from press and bystanders alike shows officers in tactical gear releasing clouds of orange-colored and green-colored irritants at close range into crowds of residents and protestors.
Local fire and EMS reports corroborate this: emergency calls surged for people suffering from exposure to these clouds--coughing, burning eyes, trouble breathing--common symptoms associated with tear gas use.
When officials say 'tear gas,' they are almost always referring to CS, or _ortho-chlorobenzylidene malononitrile_ --a specific chemical irritant with a well-documented, relatively predictable health profile--not obscurant smoke devices or other chemical agents.
So what _exactly_ is being used? What's in that smoke?
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/70eca207-1111-48ba-ad7c-e8d525f8d954?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

* * *
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=3722532&post_id=184809132&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTg0ODA5MTMyLCJpYXQiOjE3Njg1OTczODYsImV4cCI6MTc3MTE4OTM4NiwiaXNzIjoicHViLTM3MjI1MzIiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.35ByCMNbt3pPbGk_dxI5GPOlMbiUV2r2T3Nx-C9HNmQ)
* * *
#### There Is a Precedent for Toxic "Smoke" munitions Being Used in Crowd Control
This is where the question stops being rhetorical and starts being urgent.
In other cities, most notably Portland, Oregon, during the protests of 2020, federal law enforcement _was documented or alleged_ to have deployed munitions that weren't simple tear gas canisters. City officials in Portland reported that federal officers used **hexachloroethane ( "HC smoke") devices**--smoke grenades that produce a dense, toxic cloud.
Hexachloroethane (HC) smoke and other zinc-chloride-producing chemical agents are prohibited for use as weapons in international armed conflict under the Chemical Weapons Convention, which bans the use of toxic chemicals as methods of warfare.
While the treaty allows limited domestic law-enforcement use of certain irritants like CS tear gas, HC smoke is not classified as a standard riot-control agent and is widely recognized in international medical and military literature as **too dangerous for crowd control**.
Here's the critical part: **hexachloroethane smoke is not a mild irritant.** The mainstream chemical literature, medical case reports, and toxicology profiles identify the dense smoke produced by these devices--dominated by chemicals like zinc chloride--as capable of causing **severe respiratory damage** , chemical burns, and _long-term lung injury_. _Some exposures in closed environments have even been fatal_.
The Union of Concerned Scientists recently reported that [Safariland, a chemical weapons company, has changed the labeling on the munitions to falsely sell them as non-hazardous](https://substack.com/redirect/6a3d916c-0b49-4e55-bbb5-42fc058d653f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Sell them to whom?
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/70eca207-1111-48ba-ad7c-e8d525f8d954?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Minneapolis, Jan 9, 2026 Reuters
* * *
[Leave a comment](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=3722532&post_id=184809132&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&isFreemail=true&comments=true&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTg0ODA5MTMyLCJpYXQiOjE3Njg1OTczODYsImV4cCI6MTc3MTE4OTM4NiwiaXNzIjoicHViLTM3MjI1MzIiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.35ByCMNbt3pPbGk_dxI5GPOlMbiUV2r2T3Nx-C9HNmQ&r=1hvr60&utm_campaign=email-half-magic-comments&action=post-comment)
* * *
#### So What Does That Have to Do With Minneapolis?
In Minneapolis, protestors and bystanders were again reporting _chemical clouds_ --but there's been no official clarification on _what chemicals_ federal agents are using. The government's public statements have stuck to generic phrases like "tear gas" or "irritants," and the local reporting has mirrored that language without specificity.
Is it reasonable to assume that federal agents aren't using the same kinds of munitions they have in the past?
Think about this pattern:
1. Federal agencies deploy munitions without transparent disclosure of chemical agents--Minneapolis demonstrations are now being met with vague references to "tear gas" or "chemical irritants."
2. In Portland, federal officers used munitions that may not have been simple tear gas--City officials themselves raised concerns about "HC smoke" devices' deployment in 2020.
3. No independent testing of the chemicals in Minneapolis has been released yet--That means the actual content of the plumes filling residential streets remains unknown.

Given this pattern, it would be naive and irresponsible to take the government's blanket "tear gas" description at face value.
This is not about semantics; it's about health and civil rights.
Tear gas has a known profile: it causes burning eyes, coughing, and mild respiratory distress in most cases, and wears off as you exit the thickest concentrations. It's painful, yes--and it's already banned for use in warfare for good reason--but most adults recover after a few minutes to hours once far enough away.
But **hexachloroethane smoke and zinc-chloride-dominated smoke munitions are a different beast**. They can:
* cause severe lung injury (chemical pneumonitis), requiring hospitalization;
* lead to long-term respiratory damage;
* prompt multi-organ effects beyond just the lungs;
* and in some documented cases, lead to fatal complications.

Neurological symptoms linked to HC smoke exposure are typically secondary to lung injury, systemic toxicity, and oxygen deprivation--but they are real, documented, and potentially severe, particularly with high-dose or enclosed-space exposure.
These neurological effects include dizziness, confusion, altered mental status, and--in severe cases--loss of consciousness or seizures, sometimes emerging hours after exposure.
To the families who live in the neighborhoods where these agents are being deployed--children, elderly residents, people with asthma or compromised lungs--this isn't abstract.
_**This is life and death.**_
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/70eca207-1111-48ba-ad7c-e8d525f8d954?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Minneapolis. Jan 15, 2026. NYT
#### Minnesotans Deserve to Know What They're Breathing
Here's the core of the outrage:
* Protesters in Minneapolis are being met with chemical irritants.
* Federal agencies have a documented history of deploying toxic smoke devices without clear public disclosure.
* Minnesota officials have been forced to use court action and public pressure to even get answers about what's happening on their streets.

And yet **not once has there been a transparent inventory of the specific agents used** so far in January 2026.
This matters because if these are _ordinary_ tear gas canisters, the medical community has decades of data on short- and long-term impacts. But if these are _toxic smoke devices like HC smoke_ , then we are in a completely different regime--one where residents are being exposed to potent, lung-damaging chemicals without consent or warning.
* * *
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYmx1ZWFtcC5jby9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.HpzHXq3smlNeeMIG7FEUdzWwZZozi9oQPDjtUDrz-Tw?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=184809132)
* * *
#### Reasonable But Outraged: A Demand for Answers
Let's be clear: I'm not saying definitively that ICE is using hexachloroethane smoke in Minneapolis. What I am saying is this:
* **Based on pattern, precedent, and lack of transparency from federal agencies** , it _is entirely plausible_ that the agents deployed here go beyond simple tear gas.
* **Communities have a right to know what chemicals they are being exposed to** , especially when federal agents are using force in residential neighborhoods.
* **Media and public officials should not accept generic, non-specific terms like "irritants" as an answer** when there is evidence of more dangerous munitions being used elsewhere.

So let's ask the question bluntly, without fear of warning labels or political pushback:
💥 **Is it possible that ICE is using a markedly toxic chemical weapon in Minneapolis --one that goes far beyond tear gas?**
If we can't ask that question, we can't protect America.
And if the federal government won't answer it, then Minnesota residents, journalists, scientists, public health officials, and every concerned American must demand the truth.
And we must do it before another plume of unknown smoke reaches a child's lungs.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/70eca207-1111-48ba-ad7c-e8d525f8d954?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

A documented federal precedent, a cloud of secrecy, and a city demanding to know what's in the air | | and | Jan 16 | | | ---|---|--- | | | | | | | | | | | | | ---|---|--- | | ---|---|--- by Lawrence Winnerman, BAM COO and Writer ( Apologies to the band "", whom I adore.) There's being angry about what's happening on the streets of Minneapolis right now, and then there's being terrified for our communities and for the state of our nation. In the two weeks since an ICE agent shot and killed 37-year-old Renee Nicole Good--a U.S. citizen and mother--Minneapolis has erupted in protest, grief, and fear. Thousands have taken to the streets, not just in Minneapolis, but in cities across the country, demanding accountability and an end to a federal force that many people clearly see as hostile and not protective. But beyond the anger that we are all feeling, a deeper and more deadly question needs to be answered:it possible that ICE and federal immigration agents are deploying a toxic chemical weapon against the people of Minneapolis? And while it feels crazy to say it like this--I don't mean "just" tear gas. I mean something far more dangerous -- something that has been described elsewhere as a toxic smoke weapon capable of severe injury. | | ---|---|--- Reuters We Already Know DHS Has Used Chemical Irritants Let's start with what we know we can confirm. Multiple news agencies and dozens of on-the-ground videos show federal agents in Minneapolis deploying chemical irritants and tear gas to disperse crowds and quell protests in the days since Good's killing. . The NYT recently reported that ICE targeted a family car with six children in it, and that . Footage from press and bystanders alike shows officers in tactical gear releasing clouds of orange-colored and green-colored irritants at close range into crowds of residents and protestors. Local fire and EMS reports corroborate this: emergency calls surged for people suffering from exposure to these clouds--coughing, burning eyes, trouble breathing--common symptoms associated with tear gas use. When officials say 'tear gas,' they are almost always referring to CS, or ortho-chlorobenzylidene malononitrile --a specific chemical irritant with a well-documented, relatively predictable health profile--not obscurant smoke devices or other chemical agents. So what exactly is being used? What's in that smoke? | | ---|---|--- Reuters Jan 13, 2026 Minneapolis, MN There Is a Precedent for Toxic "Smoke" munitions Being Used in Crowd Control This is where the question stops being rhetorical and starts being urgent. In other cities, most notably Portland, Oregon, during the protests of 2020, federal law enforcement was documented or alleged to have deployed munitions that weren't simple tear gas canisters. City officials in Portland reported that federal officers used hexachloroethane ( "HC smoke") devices--smoke grenades that produce a dense, toxic cloud. Hexachloroethane (HC) smoke and other zinc-chloride-producing chemical agents are prohibited for use as weapons in international armed conflict under the Chemical Weapons Convention, which bans the use of toxic chemicals as methods of warfare. While the treaty allows limited domestic law-enforcement use of certain irritants like CS tear gas, HC smoke is not classified as a standard riot-control agent and is widely recognized in international medical and military literature as too dangerous for crowd control. Here's the critical part: hexachloroethane smoke is not a mild irritant. The mainstream chemical literature, medical case reports, and toxicology profiles identify the dense smoke produced by these devices--dominated by chemicals like zinc chloride--as capable of causing severe respiratory damage , chemical burns, and long-term lung injury. Some exposures in closed environments have even been fatal. The Union of Concerned Scientists recently reported that . Sell them to whom? | | ---|---|--- Minneapolis, Jan 9, 2026 Reuters So What Does That Have to Do With Minneapolis? In Minneapolis, protestors and bystanders were again reporting chemical clouds --but there's been no official clarification on what chemicals federal agents are using. The government's public statements have stuck to generic phrases like "tear gas" or "irritants," and the local reporting has mirrored that language without specificity. Is it reasonable to assume that federal agents aren't using the same kinds of munitions they have in the past? Think about this pattern: 1. Federal agencies deploy munitions without transparent disclosure of chemical agents--Minneapolis demonstrations are now being met with vague references to "tear gas" or "chemical irritants." 2. In Portland, federal officers used munitions that may not have been simple tear gas--City officials themselves raised concerns about "HC smoke" devices' deployment in 2020. 3. No independent testing of the chemicals in Minneapolis has been released yet--That means the actual content of the plumes filling residential streets remains unknown. Given this pattern, it would be naive and irresponsible to take the government's blanket "tear gas" description at face value. This is not about semantics; it's about health and civil rights. Tear gas has a known profile: it causes burning eyes, coughing, and mild respiratory distress in most cases, and wears off as you exit the thickest concentrations. It's painful, yes--and it's already banned for use in warfare for good reason--but most adults recover after a few minutes to hours once far enough away. But hexachloroethane smoke and zinc-chloride-dominated smoke munitions are a different beast. They can: cause severe lung injury (chemical pneumonitis), requiring hospitalization; lead to long-term respiratory damage; prompt multi-organ effects beyond just the lungs; and in some documented cases, lead to fatal complications. Neurological symptoms linked to HC smoke exposure are typically secondary to lung injury, systemic toxicity, and oxygen deprivation--but they are real, documented, and potentially severe, particularly with high-dose or enclosed-space exposure. These neurological effects include dizziness, confusion, altered mental status, and--in severe cases--loss of consciousness or seizures, sometimes emerging hours after exposure. To the families who live in the neighborhoods where these agents are being deployed--children, elderly residents, people with asthma or compromised lungs--this isn't abstract. This is life and death. | | ---|---|--- Minneapolis. Jan 15, 2026. NYT Minnesotans Deserve to Know What They're Breathing Here's the core of the outrage: Protesters in Minneapolis are being met with chemical irritants. Federal agencies have a documented history of deploying toxic smoke devices without clear public disclosure. Minnesota officials have been forced to use court action and public pressure to even get answers about what's happening on their streets. And yet not once has there been a transparent inventory of the specific agents used so far in January 2026. This matters because if these are ordinary tear gas canisters, the medical community has decades of data on short- and long-term impacts. But if these are toxic smoke devices like HC smoke , then we are in a completely different regime--one where residents are being exposed to potent, lung-damaging chemicals without consent or warning. Reasonable But Outraged: A Demand for Answers Let's be clear: I'm not saying definitively that ICE is using hexachloroethane smoke in Minneapolis. What I am saying is this: Based on pattern, precedent, and lack of transparency from federal agencies , it is entirely plausible that the agents deployed here go beyond simple tear gas. Communities have a right to know what chemicals they are being exposed to , especially when federal agents are using force in residential neighborhoods. Media and public officials should not accept generic, non-specific terms like "irritants" as an answer when there is evidence of more dangerous munitions being used elsewhere. So let's ask the question bluntly, without fear of warning labels or political pushback: 💥 Is it possible that ICE is using a markedly toxic chemical weapon in Minneapolis --one that goes far beyond tear gas? If we can't ask that question, we can't protect America. And if the federal government won't answer it, then Minnesota residents, journalists, scientists, public health officials, and every concerned American must demand the truth. And we must do it before another plume of unknown smoke reaches a child's lungs. | | ---|---|--- Minneapolis, Jan 14, 2026. Friend – something’s been on my mind, and I need to know where you stand on it.
Donald Trump and his allies claim they’re championing “meritocracy.” But that’s absurd.
You can’t lecture me about “merit” and then make Pete Hegseth your Secretary of Defense.
You can’t lecture me about “merit” and then make Robert F. Kennedy Jr. your Secretary of Health and Human Services.
You can’t preach about promoting a “meritocracy” while filling your Cabinet with the most unfit, unqualified people ever selected.
**Let’s be clear: I’m doing everything I can to hold the line against this dangerous administration, and I need to know if you’re as concerned as I am about the threats Trump’s Cabinet poses to our country. Please, let me know now:**
**Do you approve of Trump’s Cabinet?**

I love it in the same way we love our families. Many families have a complicated story. I carry in my veins the brutal side of that. My daddy had to give up his bus seat while wearing his soldier’s uniform – but because we kept fighting for America, his son now sits in a _Senate_ seat.
No matter what Trump and his allies throw at us, I’ll never give up on the fight to make this country a better place. I’m grateful to know you’re with me in this fight.
Thanks for speaking out,
Rev. Raphael Warnock

| Peter, Happy New Year! I am back in Richmond to represent you and the rest of the 28th Senatorial District for the first week of the legislative session. The next 60 days will be arduous, but I will fight for the pro-family, pro-business, and pro-military policies that make Virginia great, fulfilling the job you elected me to do. **Constitutional Amendments** Today marks a turning point for our great Commonwealth. In the Senate Chamber, despite voicing our vociferous opposition, two disastrous Constitutional Amendments were approved by Virginia Democrats.
* [House Joint Resolution (HJ) 1](https://gkbt4brd.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Flis.virginia.gov%2Fbill-details%2F20251%2FHJ1%2Ftext%2FCHAP0600/1/0100019bc8b631fb-3f2b7984-a7d5-4fed-b58e-7934a8b66358-000000/VkWXGSa2hbtdQt8Ux_PY2XaTdkM=461) allows for a child to be aborted within the third trimester of a pregnancy.
* This Joint Resolution passed the Senate by a vote of [21 Yea to 18 Nay](https://gkbt4brd.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Flis.virginia.gov%2Fsession-details%2F20261%2Fminutes%2F3461/1/0100019bc8b631fb-3f2b7984-a7d5-4fed-b58e-7934a8b66358-000000/2tJ6g74amcirhUdL3ol5bTLsx3M=461) after being approved by the House of Delegates earlier this week.
* [HJ 4](https://gkbt4brd.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Flis.virginia.gov%2Fbill-details%2F20261%2FHJ4/1/0100019bc8b631fb-3f2b7984-a7d5-4fed-b58e-7934a8b66358-000000/HOBRwGmnlz_JiXU_HwJaq-fMHYk=461) will allow for a non-partisan redistricting commission, which, if approved by the voters, will enable Democrats to draw their own congressional maps. This will potentially eliminate representation for a large swath of Virginians despite the wishes of [65.7% of the electorate.](https://gkbt4brd.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Fx.com%2FGovernorVA%2Fstatus%2F1981698693221744709/1/0100019bc8b631fb-3f2b7984-a7d5-4fed-b58e-7934a8b66358-000000/ej2Tk1eezSFSllYHybkE-DM-YiM=461)
* This Joint Resolution passed the Senate by a vote of [21 Yea to 18 Nay](https://gkbt4brd.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Flis.virginia.gov%2Fsession-details%2F20261%2Fminutes%2F3461/2/0100019bc8b631fb-3f2b7984-a7d5-4fed-b58e-7934a8b66358-000000/xwB1OKHS8hbNS5DCt3nranLYwuo=461) after being approved by the House of Delegates earlier this week.

**Affordability** My Republican colleagues and I are staying focused on our promises to our constituents, advancing common-sense proposals to put more money back in your pockets:
* **Repeal the Virginia Clean Economy Act (VCEA)** – Saving families more than **$1,000 per year** in energy costs
* **No Tax on Tips** – Returning an average of **$280** per worker
* **No Tax on Overtime** – Saving an average of **$130** per worker
* **Repeal the Car Tax** – Putting an average of **$1,099** back into Virginians' pockets
* **Repeal the Grocery Tax** – Saving families **hundreds of dollars** annually
* **Extend the Increased Standard Deduction** – Saving up to **$600 per family**

Meanwhile, despite campaigning on reducing prices, the Democrats are pursuing an agenda that will increase costs and add new burdens on employers and workers:
* Raising the minimum wage to $15/hour, increasing costs for small businesses
* Mandatory paid sick leave and paid family leave programs totaling over **$2 billion** in new taxes
* A proposed **$1.4 billion** income tax increase on higher earners
* New or expanded taxes, including an additional local sales tax option, plus proposals for digital and services taxes totaling billions more
* Repealing **Right-to-Work** , which would force workers to pay union dues and increase the cost of doing business in Virginia

**Call to Action** The Democrats are working diligently to maintain power, all under the guise of “Election Integrity.” This is an affront to our Commonwealth, and my colleagues and I will fight tooth and nail to ensure every Virginian knows what their plan is. I implore you to speak with your friends, families, and neighbors. Ensure they are informed so that when Constitutional Amendments come to a vote, they can be defeated outright. This is nothing more than a power grab that will make Virginia less safe and less affordable for generations to come. This battle has just begun, and while I am fighting in Richmond, we need every Virginian on the front lines.

# [Michigan hope agenda ](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=6380051&post_id=184811318&utm_source=post-email-title&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTg0ODExMzE4LCJpYXQiOjE3Njg1OTkzODAsImV4cCI6MTc3MTE5MTM4MCwiaXNzIjoicHViLTYzODAwNTEiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.3OLtmzjxyBLm6yCofSY6UqGvFMy8EMVVv5Xvdl3YIps)
### A love letter, a vision, a promise
| | [Haley Stevens](https://substack.com/@haleyformi)
---
| Jan 16
---
| [](https://substack.com/@haleyformi)
---

---
| | | [](https://substack..mNYGr3a-xVrmv-aprlL82PN2i067u-N7Ur4mY8n02ks?&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email)
---
| | [READ IN APP](https://open.substack.com/pub/haleyformi/p/michigan-hope-agenda?utm_source=email&redirect=app-store&utm_campaign=email-read-in-app)
---

Hi friends,
I have something special to share today.
After months of conversations, listening sessions, town halls, coffee chats, and late nights banging out the details, I'm proud to officially announce the **Michigan Hope Agenda**.
This is my plan to grow our economy, create good-paying jobs, and break down the barriers that keep too many Michiganders, especially in communities of color, from accessing the opportunities they deserve.
But it's more than a plan. _It 's a promise. A love letter._ And it's deeply personal.
**This agenda is built on what I 've learned from the diverse communities I know and love **- not just on the campaign trail, but throughout my life and career here in Michigan. It's about putting my hand up to deliver _real_ solutions for _real people._
That's the mindset I carried with me during the Great Recession, when I served as Chief of Staff on President Obama's Auto Rescue. Together, we helped save 200,000 Michigan jobs at a time when our auto industry and our state were on the brink.
And it's how I've served in Congress: fighting for working families, championing Michigan's manufacturers, securing federal investments for historically underserved communities, and always showing up for the people who make this state run.
**I love Michigan. And I know we can do more - not just survive, but **_**thrive**_**.**
That's what the **Michigan Hope Agenda** is all about.
It's built on seven key pillars that came directly from conversations with Michiganders at kitchen tables, union halls, school gymnasiums, and church basements. Here they are:
🛠️ **Equitable Federal Investment
** Make sure federal dollars go where they're needed most - to underserved communities that have been overlooked for too long.
📈 **Economic Empowerment and Access
** Back our small businesses, invest in workforce training, and build an industrial policy that creates jobs and lowers costs, especially in places that have been left behind.
🏘️ **Safer Communities
** Support prevention programs, fair and accountable policing, and commonsense gun safety laws that actually protect families.
💊 **Health and Family Stability
** Lower health care costs, protect science-based care, and ensure every Michigander can access the care they need with dignity.
📚 **Education, Innovation, and the STEM Workforce
** Prepare the next generation for the industries of the future, and make sure those jobs are rooted right here in Michigan.
🚰 **Water and Infrastructure
** Make clean, safe drinking water a right, not a privilege for the wealthy. No more lead pipes. No more PFAS. No more environmental injustice.
🏡 **Affordable Housing
** Increase housing supply and expand access to homeownership so families can build security, stability, and a better future.
If you're thinking this sounds like a big vision, you're right. But I know Michigan, and we're up to the task.
I've said it before, and I'll say it again: This campaign isn't about me. It's about _us_.
It's about every single Michigander who's been left behind, pushed aside, or counted out. Every small-business owner trying to keep the lights on. Every parent who wants a better life for their child. Every community that's been ignored or underfunded.
**The Michigan Hope Agenda is for you.**
It's a blueprint to build a Michigan that works for _everyone_ - not just the well-connected.
Yes, we've got work to do. But this is Michigan - let's roll up our sleeves and get it done.
**Together.**

Every one of us lives with tension - the tug-of-war between the two of us living in all of us. In DIVIDED, Pastor Jackson Lahmeyer gets real, raw, and deeply relatable as he opens up about his own struggles with pride, anger, and failure while chasing God's purpose. Through humor, honesty, and hard-learned wisdom, Lahmeyer invites readers to drop the mask, confront the "dark me" that keeps surfacing, and experience the transforming power of grace. This is not a polished preacher's pep talk-it's a gut-level, heart-to-heart conversation about what it means to follow Jesus when life gets messy. Drawing from the lives of biblical characters like Peter, Jacob and Paul, Lahmeyer shows that even the greatest heroes of faith had moments of weakness, doubt, and defeat. He unpacks the difference between remorse and repentance, explores how belief shapes behavior, and reveals how identity-not effort-is the key to lasting transformation. With vivid stories, relatable honesty, and the truth of Scripture, he reminds us that God isn't looking for the perfect version of you-He's after the real you. Because the moment you get real with God is the moment He starts making you new. If you've ever felt like you're living two lives-the public you that looks strong and the private you that's barely hanging on-this book is for you. DIVIDED will help you see that failure isn't final, temptation isn't sin, and your past doesn't disqualify your purpose. You'll laugh, you'll be challenged, and you'll find hope in the God who meets you where you are but never leaves you there. Honest, gritty, and full of grace, this book will inspire you to feed the right wolf, renew your mind, and finally live as the "you" God designed you to be.

name: Dillan Horton
subject: Thank You for Your Support
body:
Good Afternoon,

My name is Dillan Horton, the new Field Director for Eric Jones' campaign for Congress here in the 4th District. I should start by thanking you for signing up to help out the campaign either on the website or at one of Eric's events.

Eric has a high-impact agenda to end a public corruption that sees government pay more attention to PG&E shareholders than they do PG&E customers, making sure big corporations pay their fair share of taxes, and to expand access to childcare, elder care, as well as healthcare overall.

Of course we'll need a strong team of volunteers to get Eric's message out to all the voters in the district. That's where I'm hoping you come in. I've enjoyed getting to know some of you already but we'll be reaching out to each of you to find the best way for you to help get Eric across the finishline on June 2nd, and later in November. If you have any questions or want to jump the queue and connect earlier feel free to email me here or give me a call at (214)604-9953. Thank you again for your support, and I Iook forward to working with you.

-Dillan

subject: ANTIFA tried to break us at Berkeley...
body:
Please read the following message from our sponsor.
* * *

| | | | [](https://click.em.dcdailyjournal.com/t/c/84b9b3caad3148af801112e96ae6b0f7-863278ac6b5b408b9b95f7013c3c1a8d/63)
---
Friend, They tried to break us. At UC Berkeley — one of the most hostile, left-wing campuses in America — ANTIFA tried to shut down our final campus tour stop of 2025. They showed up hours early. Wearing masks. Lighting flares and smoke bombs. Throwing paint and glass bottles at attendees. Waving Mexican and rainbow flags. They mocked Charlie’s assassination... pointing to their own necks where he was shot. They chanted: _“F*** Charlie Kirk”... “No safe space for fascist scum”... “Fascists out of Berkeley.”_ And they rushed police barricades, hoping to break through and disrupt our final campus tour stop of the semester.
---
[](https://click.em.dcdailyjournal.com/t/c/84b9b3caad3148af801112e96ae6b0f7-863278ac6b5b408b9b95f7013c3c1a8d/63)
---
ANTIFA surrounded the venue, blocking every entrance. Even after our students and attendees were leaving, ANTIFA located their exit and continued to meet them with violence. The mob swarmed every student, speaker, and parent who came to hear a message of faith, family, and freedom. A mother holding her two daughters was forced to push through a wall of protesters screaming profanity in her children’s faces. Another attendee, blood dripping from his brow, was pulled to safety after being struck in the chaos outside the event. These out-of-control Leftists weren’t satisfied with merely being heard in protest — _They wanted to pick a fight._ Police made multiple arrests. **UC Berkeley, a so-called “bastion” of free speech, turned into a war zone.**
---
| | [](https://click.em.dcdailyjournal.com/t/c/84b9b3caad3148af801112e96ae6b0f7-863278ac6b5b408b9b95f7013c3c1a8d/63)
---
But still... The event went on. A packed house. Our students didn’t retreat. They stood strong. Even when ANTIFA plotted to register for tickets to leave HUNDREDS of empty seats, our patriotic students filled the room anyways. And they gave Charlie’s legacy the tribute it deserved. Rob Schneider took the stage with humility and fire. Dr. Frank Turek brought clarity and conviction. What took place behind those doors was a powerful reminder: **Truth is louder than hate.**
---
[](https://click.em.dcdailyjournal.com/t/c/84b9b3caad3148af801112e96ae6b0f7-863278ac6b5b408b9b95f7013c3c1a8d/63)
---
| | **Friend, I need you to hear this next part — because it’s about patriots like you.** This tour? This fight? These students who keep showing up — even when it’s dangerous? They didn’t get here on their own. They got here because patriots like YOU believed in them. Because when the mobs swarmed... When the threats came in... When everyone from the fake news media to the so-called political “experts” said Gen Z was lost to the Left... And when they tried to silence this movement that Charlie built... People like you stood up. Stayed in. Kept the mission alive. And showed our young people that they’re not alone. That America is still worth fighting for. That free speech still has defenders. That faith, family, and FREEDOM still have a future. So if you’ve ever wondered if it’s working... If it’s worth it... **Let me be clear: Patriots like you are why we’re winning the American Culture War.** And now this is your chance to be part of something rare — a moment in history where patriotic young Americans are reclaiming the culture, one campus at a time. Our students on campus are truly the vanguard for saving this nation, but they need to know we have their backs. **Will you make a gift right now to send backup to the frontlines and stand with these young patriots who refuse to quit?** **[Every dollar you give today helps us protect our student leaders, send activism kits to chapters, defend free speech, and fuel our reach to change more hearts and minds.](https://click.em.dcdailyjournal.com/t/c/84b9b3caad3148af801112e96ae6b0f7-863278ac6b5b408b9b95f7013c3c1a8d/63)**
---

**Make Your Gift Here**](https://click.em.dcdailyjournal.com/t/c/84b9b3caad3148af801112e96ae6b0f7-863278ac6b5b408b9b95f7013c3c1a8d/63)
---
The Left tried to intimidate us. They tried to outnumber us. They tried to drown us out. But we didn’t blink. Our students didn’t blink. The mob at Berkeley couldn’t stop us. _Because we didn’t come to Berkeley to be liked..._ **We came to speak truth.** We came to finish what Charlie started. That’s exactly what happened. **And that’s exactly why we’re winning.** Friend, thank you. Patriots like you helped turn chaos into courage... Hate into hope... And grief into grit. Let’s keep going...
---
| | **For Charlie,** **Justin Streiff**
Chief Operating Officer
Turning Point USA
