These out-of-control Leftists weren’t satisfied with merely being heard in protest — They wanted to pick a fight. Police made multiple arrests. UC Berkeley, a so-called “bastion” of free speech, turned into a war zone. | | But still... The event went on. A packed house. Our students didn’t retreat. They stood strong. Even when ANTIFA plotted to register for tickets to leave HUNDREDS of empty seats, our patriotic students filled the room anyways. And they gave Charlie’s legacy the tribute it deserved. Rob Schneider took the stage with humility and fire. Dr. Frank Turek brought clarity and conviction. What took place behind those doors was a powerful reminder: Truth is louder than hate. | | Friend, I need you to hear this next part — because it’s about patriots like you. This tour? This fight? These students who keep showing up — even when it’s dangerous? They didn’t get here on their own. They got here because patriots like YOU believed in them. Because when the mobs swarmed... When the threats came in... When everyone from the fake news media to the so-called political “experts” said Gen Z was lost to the Left... And when they tried to silence this movement that Charlie built... People like you stood up. Stayed in. Kept the mission alive. And showed our young people that they’re not alone. That America is still worth fighting for. That free speech still has defenders. That faith, family, and FREEDOM still have a future. So if you’ve ever wondered if it’s working... If it’s worth it... Let me be clear: Patriots like you are why we’re winning the American Culture War. And now this is your chance to be part of something rare — a moment in history where patriotic young Americans are reclaiming the culture, one campus at a time. Our students on campus are truly the vanguard for saving this nation, but they need to know we have their backs. Will you make a gift right now to send backup to the frontlines and stand with these young patriots who refuse to quit? The Left tried to intimidate us. They tried to outnumber us. They tried to drown us out. But we didn’t blink. Our students didn’t blink. The mob at Berkeley couldn’t stop us. Because we didn’t come to Berkeley to be liked... We came to speak truth. We came to finish what Charlie started. That’s exactly what happened. And that’s exactly why we’re winning. Friend, thank you. Patriots like you helped turn chaos into courage... Hate into hope... And grief into grit. Let’s keep going... | | For Charlie, Justin Streiff Chief Operating Officer Turning Point USA P.S.** Friend, when the Left screamed in our students’ faces... When they mocked Charlie’s murder... Our students held the line. If you believe in what they’re doing... If you know this fight is just beginning... Team: If you didn't know, the MAGA-ified U.S. Department of Justice (DOJ) has been demanding voter data from the states since May, requesting that election officials turn over unredacted copies of voter rolls and every voter registration application submitted in the past 18 months.
Several states with MAGA-aligned Secretaries of State and opponents of voting rights in charge of elections have complied, but 10 states are holding out to protect voters from intimidation , requesting information on how DOJ and the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) intend to use the state voter data they’ve demanded.
The agencies have released contradictory statements on how the data is being used, leading the secretaries of state from Arizona, California, Colorado, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, New Mexico, Oregon, Vermont and Washington to send a joint letter demanding clarity before they turn over the sensitive registration information and expressing concerns about the “ potential lack of compliance with federal law .”
The issue is simple: The U.S. Constitution entrusts the states, not the president or his agencies, to run elections. There's no legal basis for the DOJ to demand such sensitive and personally identifying information. It's yet another overreach by a president fueled by lies and taken by sycophants who are more loyal to his every whim than the rule of law they swore an oath to uphold.

“ The Department of Justice hasn’t shown any compelling reason for wanting the sensitive voter information of every American. Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw
Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

**FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE** January 16th, 2026

**KATIE HOBBS VETOES TAX CUTS FOR WORKING FAMILIES**
_KTR: It’s Time To Fire Katie Hobbs_
**PHOENIX** — Following Governor Katie Hobbs’ veto of common-sense tax relief legislation, conservative business executive and Trump-endorsed candidate for Governor **Karrin Taylor Robson** released the following statement:
_While President Trump is doing everything he can to reverse the affordability crisis created by Joe Biden and Katie Hobbs, Hobbs is doing the opposite here at home._
_Katie Hobbs just vetoed common-sense tax relief that would have let working families and small businesses keep more of what they earn. She chose bigger government and her far-left agenda over hard-working Arizonans._
_As governor, I will work tirelessly to lower costs, cut taxes, stop burdensome regulations, and make Arizona affordable again. It’s time to fire Katie Hobbs!_
---
| |
**About Karrin Taylor Robson** Karrin Taylor Robson is a lifelong conservative and business executive running for Governor of Arizona with President Trump’s endorsement.
Just like President Trump, Karrin is not a politician; she is a self-made business executive who has built one of the state’s leading land-use and economic development firms. Her work has helped bring jobs, opportunity, and growth to Arizona while cutting through bureaucracy and fighting government overreach. She’s also served on key military and education boards that impact Arizona families every day, including for more than 20 years on the Air Force Chief of Staff’s Civic Leaders Group.
A proud wife, mother, and grandmother, Karrin is running for Governor to keep our communities safe, fix, root out waste, fraud, and abuse in Arizona, and she will always have President Trump's back.

name: State Representative Ryan Chamberlin
subject: Newsletter from Rep. Ryan Chamberlin
body:
Newsletter from Rep. Ryan Chamberlin | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/repryanchamberlin/newsletter-from-rep-ryan-chamberlin-12931970?e=d1c1b9864f)
---
| |
---
| | **NEWSLETTER FROM REP. RYAN CHAMBERLIN**
---
|
---
| Friends and Neighbors,

This past week marked the start of the **2026 Legislative Session,** and I was glad to be back in Tallahassee getting to work on behalf of our district. I look forward to working alongside my colleagues to advance legislation that **puts Florida first!** As session gets underway, my focus remains on protecting freedoms, supporting families, and strengthening Florida’s future. **I look forward to sharing updates as we make progress in the weeks ahead.**

As always, please do not hesitate to [contact my office](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=eed0674a01&e=d1c1b9864f) if there is something we can do for you. My team and I would be more than happy to help you in any way we can.
---
| | _**Committee Meetings**_
---
|
---
| **I have the honor of serving on several important committees for the upcoming 2026 Legislative Session.** Committee week six is now complete, and these meetings continue to shape the policies and priorities we will carry into the new year.
* [Human Services Subcommittee](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=8156722e1a&e=d1c1b9864f)
* [Justice Budget Subcommittee](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=7011869b4d&e=d1c1b9864f)
* [Economic Infrastructure Subcommittee](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=292f365353&e=d1c1b9864f)
* [Intergovernmental Affairs Subcommittee](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=31c087695b&e=d1c1b9864f)

---
| | _**Events & Receptions Attended in Tallahassee**_
---
|
---
| **Honored to receive the Champion of Education Award from Take Stock in Children.** This recognition reflects the important work being done to expand access to education, mentorship, and opportunity for students across our community.

I’m grateful for**Take Stock in Children’s continued commitment to helping young people reach their full potential,** and I remain committed to supporting policies that invest in education and create pathways to success for every student.

While in Tallahassee, I also attended several events and receptions, including the **Southern Group Legislative Reception** , the **PBA Pre-Session BBQ** , the **Bills, Beers & Business Legislative Reception**, **Palm Beach County Day Reception** , **JMI Red, White and Bluegrass** , the **Associated Industries of Florida Reception** , and the **Consortium of Florida Education Foundations Reception.** These events provided valuable opportunities for me to connect with leaders from across the state and discuss priorities as the legislative session gets underway.
---
| | _**Meetings in Tallahassee**_
---
|
---
| Had a productive meeting with the **Marion Soil and Water Conservation District** to discuss their ongoing efforts to protect our natural resources and promote responsible land and water management in our community.

I appreciate the work they do every day to **balance growth with stewardship** and look forward to continuing to work together on these important priorities.

Also, while in Tallahassee, I met with representatives from **Florida Marine Industry** to learn more about their priorities and the role they play in supporting our state’s economy. I also attended a **Public Education Foundation award presentation** , recognizing outstanding contributions to education and the continued importance of investing in our students and schools.
---
|
---
|
---
| Had the opportunity to meet with the **President of Samaria, Yossi Dagan.**
---
| |
---
|
---
| **Met with the PBA (Police Benevolent Association) during Corrections Day at the Capitol.** Corrections Day is about recognition, respect, and support for the men and women who serve behind the walls to keep our prisons and the public safe. I am proud to stand with and support Florida Law Enforcement.
---
| | _**Events Attended in the District by Staff**_
---
|
---
| Congratulations to **Transitions Life Center** on the completion of their new **6,000-square-foot campus expansion,** celebrated this week. This project reflects a shared commitment to expanding services and opportunities for individuals with special needs in our community.

The expansion was made possible through the generosity of private donors and funding from the state, demonstrating how public and private partnerships can come together to make a meaningful impact. **This investment will allow Transitions Life Center to continue serving families across Marion County and beyond.**
---
|
---
| | _**Meet My Legislative Team**_
---
|
---
_Zak Poore pictured with our Great Governor Ron DeSantis. _
---
_Zak Poore, Rep. Chamberlin, and Ben Rembaum_
| **Wanted to introduce everyone to my legislative aide, Zak Poore**. This is Zak's first session in the Florida House.

I've had the privilege now of having **2 full-time legislative aides in Tallahassee** over the past 3 years. **Ben Rembaum for 2 years,** and now **Zak Poore in year 3**. It is impossible for me to do my job here without them.
Ben came up to visit opening day.

And while we're up here, **my** **district aide Haylee Austin,** who's been with me all 3 years, is keeping things on track back in the district. I'm blessed to have a great team.
---
|
---
| Looking forward to closing out the final committee week next week as we prepare for the 2026 legislative session, which begins on January 13. Thank you for your continued support of my leadership in the Florida House! I look forward to sharing with you again soon.

Have a great week!

Best regards,

**Ryan Chamberlin**
******State Representative**
**District 24**
---

body:
| | | A teenager kidnapped from his job at Target, bloodied, and dumped in a parking lot. A man driving to work whose car was rammed by ICE, his neighbors tear gassed, because he looked “illegal.” A mother shot in the head while driving away, after dropping her son off at school. _All of this violence just this month._ And these are just a few of many stories unfolding in Minnesota and across the country. **After treating our immigrant friends and neighbors inhumanely for years, ICE has ramped up their illegal attacks on all members of our communities, and they show no signs of stopping. On the contrary, they're only being emboldened by Donald Trump's full-throated support and threats to invoke the Insurrection Act to shut down lawful protests.** As we continue to fight for a government that will abolish ICE and end the terror for good, we need to take immediate action to support Minnesotans who are under attack right now. Here are a few quick actions you can take right now to help reduce harm in communities under siege.
1. **Keep Minnesotans fed.** As many Minnesotans, particularly immigrants, are unable or afraid to leave their homes to go to work, local food banks need more resources to keep communities fed. **[Donate to Second Harvest Heartland, which has helped to provide more than 145 million meals across Minnesota and western Wisconsin.](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMSyRD5NScRr35EUYN5oetVRjSkb8AB_y5t95Npg7GvhyYSGEVBWx4kbzdi1HWKozY0PUYZyLqdPGHy5t_pZ8TqEsqP5wmp3yv14QWsU0cBhh_bzyg5ZaejivpGTZPo27tmOnD3Fk2niUaLoSnP2P5YClNqNX8XQ8qdmcHEB-19ZMsuuiUku8AFYsqWrvsnEEyk87Q_AvNHRd6gpyqGu8VpBEU-LdU3t3xD1I-WXsdISh1v5w1xX-8_2w6pD7aiehtxFzYFeNsfGuYEDoKrwVsZQWuHS7KGiwojQ1gej1V-xL/4nc/zNCJ4QHvTqKCgMnbPFfWWg/h0/h001.kv_uNxzDHuKS3kbesR9j_xIGQOQDnSnwRhK_LbGzME4)**

I made this pledge because I have seen what happens when special interests have a seat at the table while working families are left behind. Whether it is the rising cost of groceries, the fight for labor rights, or protecting our public schools, I only want to be accountable to you. Because I refuse corporate money, this campaign belongs entirely to our community. Your donations are the fuel that keeps us moving. As we head into 2026, I keep thinking about what's ahead for our staff, our candidates, and our members.

This is the moment when we build upon all the work we did in 2025 and gear up for the midterm elections up and down the ballot this November. It's time for me to get back out on the road and support our candidates on the ground — in their communities, at rallies and town halls, and at campaign stops where the stakes feel especially real.

One of my favorite moments is standing at a rally, scanning the crowd, and spotting an EMILYs List "Elect Women" t-shirt. It's a small thing, but it says everything. It's a reminder that our movement shows up. There's nothing like the energy of our members, who know what we're fighting for and are ready to win.

That energy matters. Our candidates feel it. Our campaigns are stronger because of it. And it's what turns early momentum into real victories on election night.

The road to victory in 2026 is already underway. Every mile we travel, every voter we reach, and every EMILYs List woman we elect is powered by members like you, Peter!

Being threatened with investigation, arrest and hanging by the President of the United States.
The very sad and disappointing fact is that to this president, the truth doesn't matter and facts don't matter. And anyone who disagrees with him becomes an enemy, and he then weaponizes the federal government against them. It's legal intimidation and physical intimidation meant to get you to shut up.
He uses legal harassment as an intimidation tactics to scare people out of speaking up. He’s done it to law firms, universities, private sector companies, politicians, and private individuals.
I'm up next...
But it’s not going to work.
I swore an oath to the Constitution, many times, most recently one year ago as a United States Senator. An oath to the Constitution -- not to any one man, not to any one president.
I've taken that oath seriously ... every time.
Right now speaking out against the abuse of power is the most patriotic thing we can do, so I am not going to take these attacks lying down. But fighting back requires a legal strategy -- and the unfortunate truth is that requires resources. And the single greatest source of financial support I have is the response from people who care ... like you.

| Peter,

As I get ready for the inauguration, I’ve been thinking a lot about what this moment represents — not just for me, but for everyone who believed in this campaign and worked to make it possible.

I ran for Governor with a clear promise: to put Virginia families first, lower costs, strengthen our schools, and keep our communities safe. I feel incredibly hopeful about the work ahead and deeply honored by the responsibility Virginians have entrusted to me.

**But I also know this truth: winning an election is only the beginning.**

The progress we fought for doesn’t happen automatically. It happens because people stay engaged. After all, leaders are supported, and we continue to invest in the values and candidates who can deliver real results.

So, thank you for continuing to stand by me in this next chapter.

With appreciation,

Abigail Spanberger

WASHINGTON — Congress is taking steps this week toward averting another government shutdown, but funding the Department of Homeland Security has become a thorny issue in that effort.

After an Immigration and Customs Enforcement agent fatally shot Renee Good in Minneapolis last week, some Democrats, angry with the Trump administration’s immigration crackdown, are opposed to funding the agency without reforms.

Sen. Katie Britt, R-Ala., the chair of the Homeland Security Appropriations Subcommittee, is negotiating with Democrats to find a pathway forward on the bill before funding runs dry Jan. 30.

name: Abdul El-Sayed
subject: If billionaires and corporate PACs hate me, it means I’m doing something right
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Abdul for U
body:
Peter, we won't win this election by being moderately liked.
We'll win by _inspiring_ people. By fighting for a politics that values working people over corporations. By being unapologetically authentic.
And if the result of that is pissing off some corporate PACs and billionaires in the process?
**I'm perfectly okay with their hatred.**
I want to tax billionaires. I want to get corporate greed out of politics. I want to pass Medicare for All and guarantee healthcare for every American.
That makes me enemy #1 for them, and if billionaires and corporate PACs hate me, it means I’m doing something right.
But that also means they're going to come after us with everything they've got.
They'll spend millions on attack ads. They'll flood this race with dark money. They'll do whatever it takes to stop us because they know I won't play ball with them once I'm in the Senate.
If we’re going to overcome their deep pockets, it’s going to take a grassroots movement strong enough to match them — dollar for dollar, person by person.
By pitching in $5 or any amount today, you'll help us build a campaign strong enough to take on the billionaires and corporate PACs trying to stop us. **Peter, can I count on your support?**

This Monday is Martin Luther King Jr. Day.
Dr. King knew that our laws carry a promise: the hard-fought laws of the Civil Rights era, privacy and consumer protection laws, labor laws, and so many more exist to protect us and hold the powerful to account.
But those laws don’t enforce themselves . We have to put those protections into action.
That’s why David is running for Attorney General. He’s running to enforce the law against ICE officers who break them and terrorize our communities, to stop AI companies from discriminating against us while jacking up utility costs, to crack down on corporations that steal our time and money.
We hope you’ll join us this Monday at the MLK Marade — to honor Dr. King’s legacy and build a movement that demands the law work for all of us, not just the wealthy and well-connected.
Join Julie Gonzales and David Seligman at the MLK Marade this Monday: [https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeyLnaOFiLQqU0dvwPFVWc4Dg88XrNIjORKkezL5Ie2CU6Chw/viewform]

It didn’t stop when the FBI wanted to talk to me and other members of Congress. Because now the Department of Defense has announced that it is escalating its investigation into me. All for saying things the president didn’t like to hear. If you’re feeling like this isn’t the country you grew up in, I don’t blame you. But I hope you aren’t giving up on it, Peter. I certainly haven’t. This country has given me too much, and I’ll never be able to repay that debt. I still believe in our democracy, our values, and our Constitution. There’s no chance in hell that somebody like Donald Trump is going to stop me from serving the people of this nation. None. My Michigan Hope Agenda

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. [To unsubscribe from this email list, please click here.](https://act.haleyformi.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?&t=1&akid=1967%2E49239%2EjZXPuV)

---
Null,

I have some exciting news.

**Today, I’m announcing my Michigan Hope Agenda.** It’s my plan to support our economy and create good-paying job opportunities for all Michiganders.
Before I dive into the details, I want to ask: **Do you believe Michigan deserves a senator who fights for _every_ person in _each and every_ community? _[If so, will you chip in $5 today to help power this grassroots campaign?](https://act.haleyformi.com/go/12291?t=3&akid=1967%2E49239%2EjZXPuV)_**
Now, about my **Michigan Hope Agenda:**

This plan is built on what I’ve learned from the diverse communities across Michigan I’ve connected with – not just on the campaign trail but throughout my life and career here in Michigan. It’s about putting my hand up to deliver real solutions for real people.
I did it during the Great Recession, when I served as chief of staff on President Obama’s auto rescue and helped save 200,000 Michigan jobs. I’ve done it in Congress, fighting to deliver for working families, small businesses, and especially Black and brown communities too often left behind.

And now, I’m doing it again.
The Michigan Hope Agenda is more than a policy platform – it’s a promise. A promise to fight for a Michigan that works for everyone – not just the well-connected.

It centers around seven key pillars:
1\. **Equitable federal investment so resources reach communities** that need them most
2\. **Economic empowerment and access** for workers and small businesses
3\. **Safer communities** rooted in accountability and prevention
4\. **Health and family stability** , with lower costs and science‐based care
5\. **Education, innovation, and a strong STEM workforce** for the future
6\. **Clean water and modern infrastructure** for all Michiganders
7\. **Affordable housing** so families can build stable, secure lives
These priorities come straight from the voices I’ve heard at kitchen tables, churches, union halls, and schools across our state. They reflect what real people need and what we deserve from our leaders.

This campaign has always been about people. And it’s about making sure Michigan works for the communities that make it strong.
Launching the Michigan Hope Agenda is a step forward. But turning hope into action takes all of us. The stakes are high in Michigan: Senate control is on the line, and polls show I’m tied with my MAGA Republican opponent.
So I’ll end where I began: **[If you believe in this vision, and if you’re ready to fight for a better Michigan, will you chip in $5 today?](https://act.haleyformi.com/go/12291?t=4&akid=1967%2E49239%2EjZXPuV)**
| | [Donate](https://act.haleyformi.com/go/12291?t=5&akid=1967%2E49239%2EjZXPuV)
---
With grit, gratitude, and so much hope.

Haley
|
* * *
**A note from Haley Stevens:** null, I’m proud to be a lifelong Michigander and the daughter of small-business owners. That’s why I’ve fought so hard for working families my entire life. Now, I’m running for Michigan’s open Senate seat to continue fighting for the people and communities I love. The path to the Senate majority runs right through Michigan, which means this race is shaping up to be the most competitive and expensive in the entire country. The GOP is already coming after me as a top target for defeat, so I’m counting on your grassroots support to fight back and win. [**If you’re in this fight with me, will you add your name to endorse my campaign?**](https://act.haleyformi.com/go/12319?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&t=6&akid=1967%2E49239%2EjZXPuV) | | | [](https://act.haleyformi.com/go/12318?t=7&akid=1967%2E49239%2EjZXPuV)

Thank you,
Haley
